About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager, you will have a significant impact on your team's operations. You will continuously enhance tools and processes for people management while collaborating with engineering managers to define new workflows and implement improvements.

This is a hybrid role located in Zielona Gora.
The salary range for this role is up to 18k PLN gross per month

What will you be doing?

Managing a multi-member team.
Consistently delivering products in line with established action plans.
Active involvement in technical tasks, including hands-on coding and software development.
Ensuring code quality and functionality through the production phase.
Upholding the quality of processes, projects, and systems agreed upon by the team.
Defining service features and components under the team's responsibility.
Continuously improving both personal and team performance by suggesting and helping implement new processes and engineering best practices.
Effectively communicating progress, achievements, and areas for improvement to team members and management.
Serving as a trusted technical authority in one or more areas, providing guidance and engineering advice to the team.
Leading discussions on team architecture and design strategies. Mentoring less experienced developers.
Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to define the team’s action plans and manage competing priorities.
Monitoring team engagement and well-being indicators.
Proactively identifying and resolving potential performance challenges within the team.
Supporting the development and career growth of team members.
Participating in recruitment processes.
Advocating for business and technical decisions made by the company within the team.

What are we looking for?

As a trusted technical authority, you will become the primary point of contact for all engineering-related matters. Extensive experience in designing, building, and deploying solutions in AWS with an unwavering focus on quality.
Comprehensive expertise in designing and delivering low-latency, high-throughput API systems using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
As a programming polyglot, you excel in delivering software systems while leveraging Agile, Lean, and DevOps methodologies, effectively leading project execution.
Writing automated tests (unit, integration, etc.), pairing, enhancing code quality, and continuous integration are embedded in your professional DNA.
Proven experience in at least one object-oriented programming language, framework, or development platform.
Experienced in developing CI/CD solutions and cloud infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet.
You believe that neglecting Continuous Delivery is a missed opportunity to learn and deliver value to clients.
Passionate about full team ownership, encompassing the entire product lifecycle and its components, including code, infrastructure, and after-hours support.
Embracing a new programming language or technology is an opportunity you eagerly pursue.
Skilled at balancing the demands of delivering high-quality products while meeting challenging deadlines and committed to fulfilling your responsibilities.
Your actions consistently demonstrate that collaboration is the best path to delivering outstanding products.

The tech stack

C# .NET or Java

TypeScript

Javascript

Python

Amazon Web Services

What do we offer?

🏢💻 Hybrid Framework
- The best of both worlds! Work from home when you need focus and flexibility, and spend 2 days a week in the office for face-to-face collaboration, sharing ideas and catching up with the team. Because some things are simply better together!

📙 Personal Training Budget.
Up to 7.000 year training budget (certifications, conferences attendance, etc.) to invest in your professional development. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.

📺 Internal and external training, free access to online training platforms
such as Linkedin Learning

🗺️ Languages classes
every week. Thirsty for knowledge? Learn a new language by joining our free English/Spanish/German classes. You can connect and enjoy taking up a new language or improving your current skills with one of our great instructors.

💜 Lunch card.
Enjoy a subsidized lunch card and grab a meal with your teammates — because the best conversations often happen over lunch!

🏥 Free private medical insurance
. Take care of your health with private medical care fully covered by us

📄 Attractive life insurance
. Extra peace of mind for you and your loved ones.

🏐
Co-financed Multisport card - We support an active lifestyle because staying healthy and feeling good matters.

😊 Volunteer day.
You can take 16 hours per year in order to participate in volunteering activities! We will love to see some pictures in our slack!

🌅 Up to 30 days of vacation per year (
additional days are granted along with seniority at AUCTANE).

💙 Up to 1000 PLN/year PLN/year to match your NGO donations
! We are happy to support your initiatives by duplicating the amount donated.

👩‍⚕️We have an Employee Assistance Program
with psychological assistance free of charge for you and your loved ones.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review:
We are reviewing the salaries of all our teams annually in order to evaluate an increase according to individual performance and the business results.

Referral Fee
🔗 We need your support in hiring top-class talent! We offer a referral bonus of 4k-20k PLN, depending on the complexity of the role and the hiring process.

💜 An inclusive and upbeat work environment
Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

🌍 A cross-cultural atmosphere
We are a truly international team of 20 nationalities that speak 10 languages. Our company language is English and all internal communication and company-wide meetings are in English.

🏟️ Company events
We do our best every day, even at our regular team-building events.

🏢 Nice Office in Zielona Gora and Wroclaw
(free drinks, snacks…)

Do you want to know a little bit more about the team? Please, don’t hesitate to reach out to Amazing Auctane-PL and our Instagram

jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior MS Dynamics Business Central Developer
, you will join our global Tech team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical backbone of our operations. In this senior role, you will take full ownership of core development initiatives, optimize complex system architectures, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to engineer innovative, scalable solutions. Driving continuous technical improvement and performance, your work will directly enable our operational excellence and international growth. This position is permanent
and based in Warsaw
.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design, develop, and implement advanced customisations and extensions for MS Dynamics Business Central using AL and related technologies to support Westwing’s multi-country, multi-language, and multi-currency operations
Lead the technical architecture for Business Central, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with overarching business goals
Collaborate closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust, high-performing technical solutions
Optimise and maintain Business Central environments, ensuring high availability and seamless integration across our system landscape
Develop and maintain integrations across Westwing’s IT portfolio, leveraging APIs, Power Platform, and modern integration tools
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues to guarantee high performance, minimal downtime, and maximum operational efficiency
Continuously evaluate new Business Central features, Azure services, and modern development tools to drive automation, technical innovation, and efficiency

YOU COME WITH

5+ years of hands-on development experience with MS Dynamics Business Central or Dynamics NAV, ideally within a Microsoft Partner or enterprise environment
Deep expertise in AL programming, Visual Studio Code, and Business Central development frameworks
Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-quality technical solutions for complex business processes
Strong knowledge of modern integration techniques, including APIs, Web Services, and Power Platform
Practical experience leveraging AI-powered tools and services to enhance ERP functionality
Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on optimising Business Central performance
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, paired with fluency in English

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
A flexible hybrid setup with 2 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
20 to 28 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces
Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest

ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer
jobs.description:
🔵 Project Description:

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC -Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Your Skills And Experiences

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
- Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
- Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C#, PowerShell, Python
- Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
- Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
- Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
- Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
- Proactive thinking, excellent problem-solving, and analytical skills
- Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
- Fluent in English

Preferred Skills

- Strong coding skills (e.g. C#, PowerShell)
- Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
- Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
- Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
- Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

🔵 Responsibilities:

- Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.
- Manage Fabric-native catalog and discovery functionalities.
- Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.
- Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.
- Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.
- Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.
- Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.
- Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.
- Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.
- Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.
- Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.
- Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.

Microsoft Azure DevOps,

experience in building AI Landing zones,
experience with FabricIO & o365 agents,

self-driven/self-motivated,

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer - Netwrix Privilege Secure Discovery
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

This role ensures the quality and reliability of Netwrix Privilege Secure Discovery product, Netwrix's on-prem privileged access management platform. The SDET builds and owns test automation, quality infrastructure, and CI gates across the API, worker, and web tiers, working closely with engineers on design reviews and with the system-tests/emulator environment that validates real target-system behavior (Windows/Linux/RADIUS).

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (unit, integration, system/E2E) for the Node/Express API, Python worker services, and AngularJS web UI
Own and expand test coverage and quality gates (lint, unit, integration, system tests) in the Docker Compose–based CI pipeline
Maintain and extend the pytest-based system-tests suite that runs against emulated Windows/Linux systems and RADIUS
Write test infrastructure covering MongoDB and PostgreSQL data layers, including migrations and data integrity checks
Participate in technical design discussions to identify testability gaps and quality risks early
Investigate, triage, and root-cause test failures and production defects; drive fixes to closure with development
Develop test coverage for privileged-access workflows: credential rotation, session management, discovery/classification of privileged accounts
Champion test strategy, coverage metrics, and quality standards across the team

Required Skills

5+ years of professional experience in software test automation or SDET roles
Proficiency in Python (pytest) and JavaScript/Node.js for writing test automation
Hands-on experience with REST API testing and test framework design
Experience testing against MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL (schema validation, data integrity, queries)
Proficiency with Docker/Docker Compose for building and running test environments
Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills

DevOps

Experience with CI/CD pipelines (build, test, and deployment gates)
Basic understanding of DevOps practices

Security & Domain Knowledge

Familiarity with authentication and authorization concepts: OAuth2, JWT, SAML, LDAP/Active Directory
Basic understanding of privileged access management (PAM) or identity systems is a plus
Understanding of directory services, Windows/Linux system administration basics, and identity/access management concepts

General Skills

Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Experience working in collaborative, team-based environments
Good written and verbal communication skills in English
Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies

Preferred Qualifications

Experience testing AngularJS or other traditional server-rendered/SPA web UIs
Background testing PAM, IAM, or other security/compliance products
Experience with RADIUS or other network authentication protocols
Familiarity with VM-based or emulated system testing (Windows/Linux)
Exposure to Azure DevOps pipelines and/or GitHub Actions
Interest in AI-assisted testing/development tools

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.

eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

jobs.title: Engineering Manager — Change Systems
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Organization

Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) helps keep Netflix's engineering fleet healthy, secure, and current. We design and run the large-scale migration and modernization campaigns that move the fleet forward — from dependency upgrades to infrastructure-level changes — so that individual engineering teams don't have to absorb that toil on their own.

About The Team And The Role

The Change Systems team owns the platforms that make fleet-wide change possible at Netflix. It gives engineering teams across the company a unified way to scope, launch, automate, and validate change at scale — from routine dependency updates to complex, multi-service migrations — with as little manual toil as possible.

The platform already operates at significant scale: over 100 engineering teams run change activities across thousands of repositories, and usage continues to grow year over year. The team's mandate is expanding to match — pushing automation further using AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration. The goal is to make the majority of change at Netflix low-to-no-effort for the engineers on the receiving end, while giving the teams driving that change the tooling, telemetry, and adoption data they need to move with confidence.

You will lead the engineers who build and operate this platform, based in Warsaw. This is a team with deep end-to-end ownership: they run their own on-call, design the automation and orchestration layers directly, and are pushing the platform toward AI-driven code transformation as a first-class capability rather than a one-off tool.

End-to-end Ownership Translates Into Several Responsibilities

from a technical perspective, acting like a System Architect, driving technical architecture and component integration;
from a product perspective, wearing the Product Manager hat for Campaigns and defining the vision and strategy for the Campaigns experience;
from a partnership and stakeholders' perspective, identifying needs, incorporating feedback, aligning across the organization, creating partnerships to drive impact
from a leadership perspective, acting like a Change Agent and Advocate supporting the overall organization in shaping the mindset and approach around Campaigns (change at scale) in the agentic world;

The platform is at an inflection point, which makes this role particularly important:

From tooling to platform. Change Systems has built strong point solutions for individual campaigns. The next step is composable, declarative abstractions that every part of the platform — and the teams building on top of it — share a common foundation rather than one-off automation.
From manual campaign design to AI-assisted execution. GenAI-driven code transformation, contract-based validation, and batch orchestration are becoming core to how campaigns get executed — across code transformation, CI, testing, and delivery to production.
From reactive to metrics-driven prioritization. Using historical campaign completion data to predict bottlenecks, target specific automation investments, and measure adoption and adherence rather than simply responding to inbound requests.
From isolated campaigns to a coherent customer experience. Close technical alignment is required with Source Management, Continuous Integration, Resilience Engineering and Delivery Engineering and Security so that campaign recipients experience one coherent platform, not a patchwork of tools.

What You Will Do

Be a thought partner to Organization Champions, Campaign Managers, Campaign Recipients, and engineering leadership in setting the vision, strategy, and adoption path for fleet-wide change management as a platform capability.
Own the technical architecture direction for a composable, declarative platform that generalizes beyond any single migration use case.
Serve as a credible technical advisor to your team, helping engineers navigate ambiguous, cross-domain technical decisions — and act as the team's escalation point for novel campaigns that span multiple technical domains.
Drive AI-first ways of working across the team: treat AI-assisted code modification as core infrastructure, and advance agent-assisted engineering practices with the code review, change-risk management, testing, and evaluation rigor required to run them safely at scale.
Raise the team's rigor around impact — define meaningful adoption and adherence metrics, use historical campaign data to predict and target automation investment, and prioritize based on evidence rather than only inbound requests.
Own the operational excellence of a platform relied on across the fleet, including on-call responsibilities, telemetry and dashboards for fleet health, and feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.
Communicate complex technical and product tradeoffs clearly, in writing and verbally, to influence decisions across a broad set of stakeholders — including technical executives, SREs, and security incident commanders.
Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of engineers; challenge them to expand their ownership and grow their impact beyond their immediate scope.
Foster a strong culture of accountability, and build an inclusive team environment where every engineer feels empowered to contribute at their best.

What We Are Looking For

Experience building and operating platform systems that support large-scale, business-critical use cases, including on-call responsibilities and resilient, well-instrumented services.
Strong technical acumen in distributed systems and developer platforms, with the ability to move between architecture and implementation detail, and to represent technical decisions credibly to partner teams.
Experience building and leading inclusive engineering teams, attracting and retaining talent, and fostering a culture where individuals take ownership while contributing to shared outcomes.
Strong long-term strategic thinking and a platform mindset — able to define a technical vision for composable, extensible systems and connect it to broader organizational goals.
Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders across engineering, product, and security.
Rigor in decision-making: comfortable reducing ambiguity through a mix of data, stakeholder input, constructive dissent, and targeted experiments.
Fluency with AI-assisted engineering, with a clear point of view on how to adopt GenAI-driven code transformation and agentic tooling safely at scale.
Strong technical writing skills — design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion.

Nice to Have

Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns.
Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems.
Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations.
Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context.
Experience designing platforms where agents, not just humans, are first-class consumers — including provisioning and debugging through APIs rather than a UI.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes).

We are looking for a Forward-Deployed Architect to shape the technical direction of our solutions from day one, in the field.

As a Forward-Deployed Architect within EY's Applied AI Engineering team, you will work closely with clients and forward-deployed engineering teams, making architecture decisions that shape solutions from the first prototype across data engineering, AI and ML workflows, and agentic AI systems.

EY.AI: in this role, you will work in an environment where AI agents are part of the team and everyday project delivery. You will use solutions tailored to specific business areas to analyse data, generate recommendations and design solutions, helping teams move faster from analysis to action and create value for clients.

Your scope of duties

Embed with client and forward-deployed teams to shape the architecture of data and AI solutions from discovery through the first working prototype, across data processing, AI and ML workflows, and agentic systems.
Make fast, pragmatic technology and design decisions under ambiguity, choosing patterns that balance speed now with scalability later.
Define the target architecture and a credible path to production so validated prototypes can move seamlessly into the production build phase.
Ensure prototypes and solutions are built responsibly and securely from the start, with data handling, lineage, guardrails and compliance considerations identified early, including the EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA and model risk.
Rapidly evaluate and select tools, services and frameworks across data platforms, AI and ML, and agentic AI that fit the problem at hand.
Act as the technical translator between business intent and forward-deployed engineering teams.
Manage and grow the pool of project blueprints and accelerators.
Identify and communicate technical risk, cost and feasibility early to inform build, pivot or stop decisions.
Partner with client enterprise and solution architects to align delivery decisions with enterprise standards and reference architectures.
Present and defend the technical direction to senior client stakeholders.

Our requirements

A master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and approximately 10+ years of software, data or AI engineering and architecture experience.
A track record of designing solutions across data, AI and ML, or agentic systems and taking them from concept towards production.
Strong architecture skills and working experience in at least one of the following stacks: Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry or Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric or Synapse; AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda or Glue; or Google Cloud, including Vertex AI, BigQuery or Dataflow, together with hands-on coding ability.
A strong grasp of data architecture, including pipelines, lakes, warehouses and governance, and of AI, GenAI and agentic patterns, including RAG, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
Experience making architecture decisions under time pressure and ambiguity, ideally in a consulting, product or forward-deployed setting.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and senior business audiences.

Ideally, you'll also have

Financial services or other regulated-industry experience, and familiarity with the governance landscape, including AML and KYC, model risk or SR 11-7, the EU AI Act, DORA and GDPR.
Breadth across data engineering, AI workflows and agentic AI, and experience bridging prototype and production by defining handoffs and target architectures.
A consulting or startup background.
A history of creating reusable patterns and accelerators.

What we offer

Innovate EY, unique programmes where you can create your own start-up using our know-how and funding.
A convenient hybrid working model.
Professional and financial support in obtaining recognised qualifications and certificates.
EY Badges, global certification of your competencies and the opportunity to earn an MBA title from the prestigious Hult International School of Business.
Career Counselor, professional, one-to-one guidance on career building and development.
Psycho-educational platform, a package of free consultations with specialists in the broad field of mental health and personal development and access to educational activities.
Benefit programme offering private healthcare with additional preventive examinations, life insurance, tickets, team sports, language learning platform, sports cards and much more, available online and offline.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Additional Information

For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 19 267 PLN Gross per month (full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

jobs.title: Backend Developer - C#.NET
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad backendutveckling i ett produktbolag där tekniska beslut fattas nära utvecklarna? På Silobreaker blir du en del av ett erfaret team som bygger en plattform i världsklass för cyber- och omvärldsanalys – använd av några av världens största företag och organisationer.

Om rollen

Som backendutvecklare arbetar du med kärnan i Silobreakers plattform. Tillsammans med ett erfaret utvecklingsteam utvecklar och förbättrar du de backendtjänster som hanterar stora datamängder och driver produkten dygnet runt.

Hos Silobreaker får du vara med och lösa tekniskt utmanande problem samtidigt som du har stort inflytande över hur lösningarna utformas. De arbetar nära varandra och tror på kunskapsdelning genom bland annat kodgranskningar, parprogrammering och tekniska diskussioner.

Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

Backendutveckling i C#/.NET
Design och vidareutveckling av skalbara backendlösningar
Kodgranskning, testning och kontinuerliga förbättringar
Agilt utvecklingsarbete med sprintplanering, demos och retrospektiv
Nära samarbete med övriga utvecklare och produktteamet

Vi tror att du har:

Cirka 3–5 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
Erfarenhet av C#/.NET eller annat objektorienterat språk och ett intresse för att utvecklas inom C#
Akademisk examen inom datateknik, systemvetenskap, teknisk fysik eller liknande
God problemlösningsförmåga och ett genuint teknikintresse
Goda kunskaper i engelska

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av distribuerade system, databaser eller molnteknik, men vi lägger större vikt vid din tekniska förståelse och vilja att utvecklas än att du har arbetat med en specifik teknik.

För att trivas hos Silobreaker tror vi att du

Tycker om att samarbeta och dela kunskap
Är nyfiken och gillar att lära dig nya tekniker
Tar ansvar för kvaliteten i det du bygger
Har ett långsiktigt intresse av att utvecklas tillsammans med ett team
Gillar att förstå hur systemen fungerar – inte bara få dem att fungera

Därför ska du välja Silobreaker

Silobreaker är ett produktbolag där utvecklarna har stort inflytande och där många väljer att stanna länge. Vi är omkring 25 personer på kontoret vid Slussen i Stockholm och kombinerar tekniskt avancerade utmaningar med en prestigelös och varm kultur.

Här får du bland annat:
Arbeta tillsammans med mycket erfarna utvecklare
Stora möjligheter att utvecklas tekniskt

Career development and growth opportunities within ALTEN

As a Software Engineer, you will be part of a skilled and engaged Scrum team, working according to agile principles to design, implement, and test solutions for vehicle-to-tool communication interfaces. You will collaborate directly with stakeholders to develop common and reusable solutions that drive customer success. Your work will span the entire product lifecycle, ensuring robustness, scalability, and efficiency in a dynamic environment.

Your expertise in C# and .NET Core will be critical, but your ability to deliver end-to-end solutions, from design to support and acceptance testing, is what will truly set you apart. Develop and maintain communication interfaces between vehicles and tools, including remote operations
Design, implement, and test software solutions for the entire product lifecycle
Collaborate with stakeholders to create reusable and scalable solutions

jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker en erfaren Backend- och DevOps-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.

Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

Vad uppdraget innebär

Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
Rådgivning i design- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

Vem vi söker

Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.

Du kan drifta Azure-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.

Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

Varför uppdraget är intressant

Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

Uppdragsvillkor

Uppdragsform:
Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

Uppdragslängd:
Enligt överenskommelse.

Omfattning:
40 timmar per vecka.

Start:
Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

Arbetsplats:
Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

Ersättning:
Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

Övrigt:
Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

Var med och gör skillnad i vården!

Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.

På Doktor.Se vill vi göra saker annorlunda. Vi vill utmana och förändra en hel bransch. Allt började med en idé om att det måste gå att skapa en vårdlösning som är bättre anpassad till vår tid och våra behov. Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Och att göra det så att det inte bara blir tillgängligt för våra patienter utan också bidrar till att utveckla det sätt som vård erbjuds på idag. För oss alla. Det här är faktiskt vad vi gör idag. Men vi är långt ifrån klara och är ute på en spännande förändringsresa. Där kan du få vara med och bidra.

jobs.title: Principal Architect, E-Invoicing Solutions
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a high-impact Principal Architect
to serve as our central subject matter expert in global e-invoicing, regulatory compliance, and platform architecture. This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide reach, operating beyond traditional single-project allocation to influence delivery, pre-sales, and customer strategy. In this role, you will be the definitive go-to authority across all delivery projects, pre-sales engagements, and customer-facing interactions. You will leverage your deep mastery of the Pagero platform, hands-on integration expertise, and understanding of national e-invoicing authorities to solve complex technical challenges, shape strategic solutions, and translate intricate regulatory frameworks into clear, actionable guidance for our teams and clients.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Project Advisory & Escalation

Serve as the senior technical and functional escalation authority across all active delivery projects, resolving complex platform, integration, and compliance roadblocks.
Diagnose and solve the most challenging edge cases across the delivery portfolio, including non-standard ERP configurations, complex data transformation requirements, and multi-country mandate flows.
Design and establish reusable reference architectures, standard configuration templates, playbooks, and best-practice frameworks to scale delivery quality and consistency across the organization.

Pre-Sales & Commercial Enablement

Act as the dedicated Pagero platform and compliance expert for sales and pre-sales teams, providing deep functional and technical insight without holding direct ownership of SOW creation or pricing.
Advise solution architects and pre-sales consultants on platform capabilities, limitations, architectural fit, and feasibility.
Participate in high-stakes, customer-facing technical discussions for strategic enterprise opportunities.
Review proposed solution designs from pre-sales and delivery teams to ensure technical accuracy, platform feasibility, and regulatory alignment.

Customer Mandate & Regulatory Guidance

Act as the trusted advisor for enterprise clients navigating complex global e-invoicing mandates, clearance flows, format specifications (e.g., Peppol, UBL, XML), and government platform integrations.
Engage directly with customer stakeholders and liaise with national e-invoicing and tax authorities when necessary to secure formal regulatory clarifications.
Author and review customer-facing compliance roadmaps, mandate checklists, and country-specific onboarding documentation.

Team Onboarding, Training & Knowledge Management

Own the technical onboarding journey for new team members, developing and executing structured onboarding programs that build Pagero platform and compliance proficiency from day one.
Foster continuous skill development across delivery teams through tailored training sessions, hands-on coaching, certification guidance, and internal knowledge-sharing forums.
Build, maintain, and expand an internal Pagero Knowledge Base and learning curriculum covering country-specific mandates, integration patterns, and platform updates.
Partner with delivery leadership to identify capability gaps across teams and deploy targeted technical enablement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Deep Pagero Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience and expert-level functional and technical mastery of the Pagero platform ecosystem.
Domain Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of global e-invoicing regulations, continuous transaction controls (CTC), clearance models, Peppol networks, and digital tax reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Integration & ERP Proficiency: Strong technical background in enterprise application integration (EAI), API frameworks, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics), alongside deep familiarity with standard data formats (XML, JSON, EDI, UBL, CSV).
Architecture & Advisory Experience: Substantial experience operating in a Lead Architect, Principal Consultant, or Senior Subject Matter Expert capacity across complex enterprise deployments.
Pre-Sales Acumen: Demonstrated track record supporting pre-sales teams with technical solution reviews, discovery calls, and RFP responses.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory nuances to both executive business leaders and technical engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience directly interfacing or collaborating with national tax authorities, e-invoicing standard bodies, or working groups.
Demonstrated experience establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) or structured technical training and onboarding curriculum within an enterprise technology or consulting environment.
Relevant industry or architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Cloud Certifications, or ERP-specific accreditations).
Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to major emerging e-invoicing mandate regions (e.g., Spanish, French, German, Arabic).

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. jobs.title: Junior German-speaking Fullstack Developer – Integration Team
jobs.description:
About Parkster

At Parkster, we want to be the best at what we do. We build smart, user-friendly software, strive for top-tier customer service, and strive to be a fantastic employer. We have offices in Lund and Munich, and our services are live in around 1,400 locations across Sweden, Germany, and Austria, used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

This doesn’t stop us from chasing ambitious growth targets, quite the opposite. Together with municipalities, property owners, and private partners, we create parking solutions that are seamless today and sustainable for tomorrow.

Our engineering team currently counts just over 20 people. Many of us have years of experience, but nobody has lost the drive to solve tough problems and learn new things together.

About The Role

We have just launched a brand-new team dedicated entirely to our product integrations. These are the connections we build or configure alongside our customers and partners. Some of the most common examples are automatic license plate recognition (ANPR) cameras, EV charging, and data/statistics collection.

Initially, the team's hands-on focus will be building the integrations needed right now. Long-term, the goal is to empower others to quickly and easily configure standard integrations on their own, without needing to involve developers.

The same applies to monitoring the health of our existing integrations. To start with, you will dive in to investigate and resolve ongoing issues. We have already started visualizing this data and will set up smart alerting so that the right information reaches the right person at the right time. It’s going to be an exciting journey!

We are looking for a Junior Fullstack Developer with a solid technical foundation, high drive, and a good commercial mindset to join this team.

We are based out of our Lund office and truly value the sense of community at our workplace. While you have the flexibility to work from home a day or two a week, we hope you appreciate face-to-face collaboration and casual chats by the coffee machine just as much as we do!

Who Are You?

To thrive in this role, we believe you are someone who:

Has a solid technical foundation. Our systems are large and complex. To get up to speed, you need a broad technical baseline and a genuine desire to understand how things work under the hood. An appropriate foundation is either a masters in a related field, and/or at least two years of working experience as a developer.
Enjoys working with both people and machines. Integrations always involve another party, so it matters that you enjoy meeting potential customers and partners, both in person and online, and that you don't mind picking up the phone to get an answer or push an implementation forward.
Focuses on business value and user impact. We love building top-class technical solutions, but we always prioritize what creates the most value. The ability to evaluate, prioritize, and adjust your focus is crucial.
Is always curious to learn. You happily share your knowledge and actively seek feedback from your peers to keep growing.
You speak German and English (Swedish is a plus too!). A major part of our new integrations will be set up with partners in Germany and Austria, so you need to be able to effortlessly participate in and drive meetings with German speakers. Additionally, while our engineering language is English, our Lund office breathes Swedish, so if you can handle the daily fika chat or are eager to learn, you'll fit right in!

What We Work With

We don't hold any prestige when it comes to specific programming languages, we simply choose the best tool for the job. Today, our daily life looks roughly like this:

Backend: Java and Kotlin with Spring Boot.
Frontend: TypeScript, React, and Next.js (we also have Web Components and some legacy JSP).
Platform/Infrastructure: Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Databases: BigQuery, MongoDB, and MySQL, among others.

If you already know this stack, or if you have the drive and sharpness to pick it up quickly, you’ll love it here.

What We Offer

We are a team driven by building software that makes a real difference. Today, we are over a hundred colleagues across our offices in Sweden and Germany, enjoying close collaboration and a great community across borders and departments.

As an international growth company, we offer a fast-paced environment with plenty of room to grow. Here, you become part of a forward-thinking organization with short decision-making paths and a flat, ego-free culture.

Parkster offers great benefits, including an occupational pension, health insurance, a wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag), and above all, a workplace where we have serious fun at work.

Sounds like a match?

We recruit continuously and look forward to hearing from you. Send us your CV and a cover letter telling us a bit about what drives you.

Please note: Since it’s summertime, our response times might be a bit slower than usual over the holidays. We’ll be back in full force starting August 10th, and we appreciate your patience in the meantime!

Have any questions? Contact the hiring manager David Göransson via david.goransson@parkster.com or the Head of Development Martin Gunnarsson via martin.gunnarsson@parkster.com.

The Pangolins squad is the data protection engineering team within Data Infrastructure organization. We build and operate the systems that enable us to meet its privacy and compliance obligations at scale — covering GDPR rights like Right to be Forgotten and Subject Access Requests, data retention enforcement, and access governance.

You'll join a team of 6 engineers. Every team that stores personal data depends on the infrastructure we build. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, privacy/compliance, and product enablement — and right now, we're expanding to support our most critical regulatory initiative.

The Digital Services Act (DSA) places new obligations on very large online platforms, and our ability to meet them runs directly through our team. We're building the data governance and compliance infrastructure underpinning our VLOP obligations — with hard regulatory deadlines and real legal exposure. The work spans data cataloging, researcher data access, cross-border law enforcement data access, and ML-based tooling for personal data annotation. If you're energized by infrastructure that has real-world privacy impact and want to work at the intersection of engineering, compliance, and product — we'd love to have you on the team.

What You'll Do

Build the programmatic classification pipeline and governance data catalog behind our DSA obligations — classifying data fields across tens of thousands of endpoints and provisioning them to EU-credentialed researchers through secure environments.
Develop the governance taxonomy and data model for sensitive data categories (starting with Precise Location Data), establishing foundational infrastructure that will outlast the VLOP mandate.
Contribute to the EU e-Evidence system — cross-border law enforcement data access infrastructure — as new data categories and product features come online.
Partner with Data Governance, Content Platform, Legal, and product teams to deliver cross-org solutions that are reliable, auditable, and scalable.
Champion engineering best practices, strong architectural design, and a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

You have solid backend engineering experience in Java on Google Cloud Platform, and you're comfortable working across large-scale distributed systems.
You have hands-on experience with large-scale data infrastructure — ideally BigQuery, GCS, and Kubernetes — and can navigate complex data pipelines with confidence.
You think critically about system design and build solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and auditable at scale — especially in compliance-critical contexts.
You work well across team boundaries — with Legal, Data Governance, Product, and engineering partners — and bring clarity when requirements are evolving.
You're comfortable with ambiguity. Regulatory work moves fast; you know how to make progress even when the ground is shifting.
You care about code quality, testing, and documentation, and you build systems that are easy for others to understand and operate.
You're self-motivated and genuinely excited about infrastructure that has real-world privacy and compliance impact.

Start: asap-untill end of feb with possibility to extend
Location: Stockholm/Sweden (Remote within Sweden)

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.
Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.
You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

**We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together**

What do we need:

We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application, writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.

This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product. While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.

In this role you will get to:

Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).
Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.
Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.
Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.
Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.
Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.
Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation, and be mentored by them.

Who we're looking for:

You'll have 2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation
.

You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.

Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.

The Key Skills we are looking for:

Practical experience with Cypress
— writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.
Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript
, including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.
Experience with BDD / Cucumber
, or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.
Test case design and documentation
— the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.
Comfort with Git and GitHub
, including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.

You may also have:

Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.
Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.
Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).
Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.
A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter arkitekter som har jobbet med .NET og Azure i mange år, og som fortsatt vil skrive kode. Du går inn i kundeteam som arkitekt, med ansvar for løsningsarkitekturen i systemer som allerede er i drift.

Arbeidet

Kundene våre er mange og varierte, men ofte innenfor bransjene industri, B2B og helse. Noen er store organisasjoner med lange systemhistorier, andre er mindre virksomheter som bygger opp teknologisiden sin. Som arkitekt sitter du som regel hos kunden til daglig, men det er også plass til deg inne på vårt hovedkontor, og vi har generelt gode hjemmekontorløsninger.

Du går inn i et kundeteam som arkitekt, som regel som én av få fra Forte. Systemene har vanligvis vært i drift i mange år før du kommer, og du overtar et landskap andre har bygget. Ansvaret ditt er løsningsarkitekturen: integrasjoner, dataflyt, sikkerhet og skyplattform.

Tittelen på oppdraget varierer med kundens behov. I noen perioder jobber du mest med kode, i andre mest med arkitektur.

En stor del av oppdragene våre handler om modernisering. Eldre integrasjonsplattformer, løsninger som fortsatt kjører on-prem, .NET Framework, standardprodukter som er tilpasset så mye over så lang tid at de ikke lenger lar seg oppgradere. Oppgaven er å finne veien fra dagens situasjon til noe som holder i mange år fremover, og å gjennomføre den uten at driften stopper opp underveis.

Konkret betyr det at du

setter teknisk retning i teamet, og forklarer konsekvensene av veivalgene både til utviklerne og til dem som betaler for dem
designer og bygger integrasjoner, API-er og dataflyt i Azure, med Functions, Service Bus, API Management, AKS eller det som passer problemet
skriver kode og gjør kodegjennomganger
etablerer plattform, IaC og pipelines slik at resten av teamet kommer raskere frem
bidrar til at utviklerne rundt deg blir bedre, gjennom parprogrammering og gjennomganger mer enn gjennom presentasjoner
dokumenterer beslutninger slik at de holder også når du ikke er tilgjengelig
tar stilling til hvordan kodeassistenter og agenter brukes i teamet, og hva det betyr for arkitektur, kodekvalitet og gjennomganger

Hva rollen ikke er

Dette er ikke en virksomhetsarkitektrolle, og heller ikke en rådgiverrolle på siden av utviklingsarbeidet. Rollen innebærer ikke personalansvar. Har du beveget deg bort fra koden og trives med det, er dette sannsynligvis feil stilling, men vi har andre roller og hører gjerne fra deg om dem.

Du må ha

.NET og C# som primærplattform gjennom mange år, med nok tyngde til at du har sett hvordan valgene dine har stått seg over tid
Azure-erfaring fra produksjonsløsninger du selv har vært med på å bygge og drifte
erfaring som arkitekt eller tech lead i team der du fortsatt skrev kode
gode norskegenskaper både skriftlig og muntlig

Det teller positivt om du har

ledet et moderniseringsløp fra legacy til målbilde
bygget dataplattform eller datahub
jobbet praktisk med sikkerhet i design og implementasjon
erfaring med IaC (Bicep, Terraform) og CI/CD i Azure DevOps eller GitHub
brukt kodeassistenter i eget arbeid og gjort deg opp en mening om hvor de faktisk hjelper
dokumentert arkitektur med C4 eller tilsvarende
sertifiseringer som AZ-305, AZ-204 eller AZ-400

Du trenger ikke kjenne deg igjen i alt på denne listen for å søke.

Fagmiljøet

Arkitektene i Forte driver en guild og faste fagmøter. Innholdet lages av arkitektene selv, og temaene bestemmes av dem som ønsker å være en del av miljøet.

Vi forventer at du bidrar med sparring, mentoring og en presentasjon i blant, og vi setter av arbeidstid til det.

Hva kan vi tilby?

🌴 6 uker ferie

Du får 6 uker ferie, fra det andre året du er ansatt i Forte.

🧠 Sterkt fagmiljø

Hos oss finner du gode sparringspartnere i alt fra junior utviklere til erfarne arkitekter. Du får bidra til å påvirke faglig retning, og vi har både et eget arkitektakademi og fagmøter.

🩺 Gode forsikringsvilkår

Dekket privat helse- og reiseforsikring og gode pensjonsordninger.

🎉 Godt sosialt miljø

Vi finner alltid en unnskyldning til å samles - alt fra aktivitetesgrupper, turer og månedlige arrangementer.

👶 Full lønn i foreldrepermisjon

Du får selvfølgelig utbetalt full lønn i foreldrepermisjon.

📚 Faglig utvikling i arbeidstiden

Vi brenner for fag, og hos oss får du bruke arbeidstiden til å utvikle deg innenfor det du ønsker.

🤸 Dekket treningsavgift

Vi vet at trening kan bidra til å fremme bedre helse. Forte dekker treningsavgift for opp til 800,- per måned.

Vi er Forte og vi er et europeisk konsulentselskap. Navnet vårt betyr styrke, og det er akkurat det vi gir våre kunder. Styrken til å tilpasse seg. Til å handle. Til å vokse.

Vi hjelper våre kunder med å forbli relevante og realisere sitt fulle potensial - uansett hva fremtiden bringer. Vi kombinerer teknologi, strategi og brukeropplevelse for å gi deg det du trenger for å lede – ikke bare følge etter.

Vi drives av det som virkelig teller: Målbare resultater, verdi og varig relevans. Vi heier på kundene våre og strekker oss litt lenger for å skape resultater sammen. Med raushet og engasjement møter vi deg der du er, tilpasser oss dine behov og gir tydelig retning. Vi tar initiativ, handler raskt og er alltid et steg foran – fordi vi gir alt for at du skal lykkes.
