jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bli med på laget og vær med på å forme fremtidens subsea-sensorteknologi!

Hos Siemens Energy på Bømlo vil du arbeide med avanserte sensorsystemer som støtter kritisk energiinfrastruktur. Som en del av et tverrfaglig ingeniørteam vil du utvikle programvare innen innebygde systemer, produksjonsverktøy, automatisering og digitale løsninger som har direkte innvirkning på hvordan produktene våre utvikles, produseres og brukes.

En glimt av din hverdag

Vi utvikler programvare og hardware som optimaliserer produksjonsprosessene våre. Dette inkluderer automatisering, logging, testsystemer og datadrevne forbedringer av prosesser.

Du vil få muligheten til å lære hvordan hele systemet fungerer, fra innebygd programvare og sensorhardware til backend-tjenester og frontend-applikasjoner. Nysgjerrighet og læringsvilje er minst like viktig som tidligere erfaring.

I hverdagen vil du jobbe på tvers av fagområder og ha tett samarbeid med produksjonen, hardwareingeniører og andre interne interessenter. Derfor er det viktig med fysisk tilstedeværelse på arbeidsplassen. Hjemmekontor er mulig i noe grad, men dette er primært en stilling med arbeidssted på Bømlo.

Hvordan du vil gjøre en forskjell

Innebygd programvare for subsea-sensorer

Utvikling i C og tilhørende verktøy. Programvaren kjører direkte på sensorene våre og er avgjørende for produktenes ytelse og pålitelighet.

Interne administrasjons- og automatiseringsløsninger

Vi utvikler og vedlikeholder interne systemer, inkludert et egenutviklet ERP-system og løsninger for dokumenthåndtering. Disse systemene integreres med plattformer som SAP og Teamcenter og bidrar til digitalisering på tvers av organisasjonen.

Produksjonsverktøy og digitalisering av fabrikken

Programvaren du utvikler bidrar til å sikre kvalitet, pålitelighet og ytelse i avansert subsea-sensorteknologi som brukes over hele verden.

Vår teknologistack inkluderer blant annet C, C#, TypeScript (Svelte), Rust og tilhørende rammeverk.

Hva du bringer med deg

Vi ser etter en ingeniør som:

Kan programmere selvstendig
Har et solid fundament innen programmering og programvareutvikling
Tar eierskap til oppgaver og følger dem helt i mål
Kommuniserer tydelig og samarbeider godt med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter
Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å lære på tvers av fagområder
Arbeider strukturert og følger etablerte programvareprosesser

Utdanning innen informatikk, programvareutvikling eller tilsvarende er en fordel, men relevant erfaring og praktiske ferdigheter verdsettes like høyt.

Erfaringsnivå

Stillingen er rettet mot erfarne ingeniører. Samtidig er vi åpne for å investere i dyktige junioringeniører som ønsker å bygge en langsiktig karriere hos oss og gradvis ta større ansvar.

Hvem er Siemens Energy?
Hos Siemens Energy er vi mer enn bare et energiteknologiselskap. Med omtrent +100 000 dedikerte ansatte i mer enn 90 land utvikler vi energisystemene for fremtiden, og sikrer at det økende energibehovet til det globale samfunnet blir møtt på en pålitelig og bærekraftig måte. Teknologiene som skapes i våre forskningsavdelinger og fabrikker driver energiovergangen og utgjør grunnlaget for en sjettedel av verdens elektrisitetsproduksjon.

jobs.title: Value Architect, Data & AI
jobs.description:
A senior data and AI expert who turns data into value: advising our key clients, shaping our offering, and helping grow the business.

Do you enjoy working with modern data & AI solutions? Are you equally at home acting as a trusted advisor to clients while driving sales and shaping the offering? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help organizations turn data into real business value, from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert working across two roughly equal dimensions of the role. One half is client-facing. You act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on where unified data and AI-first delivery turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in time-to-value, quality, and decision speed, and which human-and-AI team should deliver them. The other half builds the offering and the pipeline. You shape what we sell, architect the sale, and support our teams to win, and you may take ownership of specific offerings of your own. One morning you frame the business case with a CDO. That afternoon you review a data architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with and shape

Everything we do runs on an AI-first approach: a spec-driven, agentic operating model where a small embedded team owns the product lifecycle end to end. The Nortal AI Kit sits underneath it, with skills, templates, workflows, and agents that turn business ideas and needs into AI-ready specifications, and those into enterprise-grade platforms, data products, and AI applications. This is not a separate service. It is how we deliver, and it runs through each of our core offerings:
Data & AI Platform Modernization:
unified, governed data and AI foundations that make data AI-ready at scale, delivered for example as a Databricks or Microsoft Fabric lakehouse and an AI platform such as Microsoft AI Foundry or M365 Copilot.
Edge Platform Modernization:
unified, cloud-native, edge architecture for real-time, sovereign data and AI across many sites from one control plane, compliant by design and delivered for example as Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes at the edge.
Data, AI & Analytics use cases:
data, AI, and analytics applied to business processes to create value. Built on the data and edge platforms, these use cases turn trusted, unified data into measurable outcomes: higher uptime and throughput, sharper demand and risk forecasting, lower energy use and cost, better customer targeting, and safer, more compliant operations.

You start with these, help evolve them, and shape new offerings as the market moves.

What You Will Do

The role has two roughly equal sides.

Advise our clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor
. Work with senior client stakeholders (CDOs, heads of data, business owners) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Own the architecture.
Influence architecture and design decisions so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every pipeline yourself, but you can steer an AI-first approach and stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the sale. Stay hands-on enough to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case from proposal to production.

Build the offering and win the work
Support sales.
Lead discovery and qualification (backlog size, handovers per request, time-to-delivery, platform readiness), handle the hard objections with evidence, and shape the proposal, including the solution approach, the work estimate (often AI-augmented), and the customer value case. Always close on a concrete next step, whether a workshop, a discovery project, or full-scale delivery.
Develop the offering
. Turn engagements into reusable assets and named offerings, sharpen the land-and-expand packaging, and feed proof points, patterns, and prompts back into the offering.
Help us grow.
Support growing the business, take ownership of selected offerings, mentor others, and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so growth is never bound by one person’s bandwidth.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in data and technology with business acumen
(Data Architect, Principal Consultant, Head of Data or Analytics, Solution Lead, or similar), with ten or more years across both the customer and consulting sides.
A track record of winning new, high-value customers
and engagements and growing existing accounts, with real ownership of business growth, not just delivery.
Consultative mindset.
You lead with the customer’s problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
AI-native ways of working.
Fluent use of modern AI tools (such as Claude Cowork, Claude Design) and coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Kiro). You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.
Platform familiarity.
Comfortable with modern cloud and data stacks such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Value-case construction.
An instinct for where AI and unified data remove cost rather than shift it, and the ability to turn that into a case a CFO and a CDO both believe. A commercial mindset, and ownership of your pipeline.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of at least one industry we serve (manufacturing, energy, the public sector, retail, or similar) is a strong plus, and helps you speak the customer’s language from day one.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach both technical teams and C-level stakeholders. German is an asset.

Why join us

Shape it, don’t inherit it.
You help build and grow the offering alongside the Head of Data & AI, rather than maintaining one someone else froze in place. It is an evolving, entrepreneurial role with room to leave your mark.
Work at the AI-first frontier.
Agentic, spec-driven data delivery and platform modernization applied to real enterprise problems, not perpetual pilots.
A community, not a silo.
A network of architects from several disciplines and transformation consultants behind you, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you sell.
Sell from strength.
Own your pipeline and your patterns, with the weight of a trusted partner to governments and Fortune 500 companies across Europe, the GCC, Latin America, and North America. Microsoft named us in its Industrial AI Partner Guide, one of a select group of integrators trusted to deliver industrial AI at scale.

Salary range
: 7000-9000€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

jobs.title: Erfaren C#/.NET-udvikler til opbygning af integrationsplatform
jobs.description:
Har du solid erfaring med C#, .NET og udvikling af integrationer i Azure? Kan du omsætte tekniske krav og arkitekturprincipper til robust kode, veldesignede API’er og løsninger, der fungerer stabilt i drift? Så kan du blive vores nye kollega.

Du får en central teknisk rolle i udviklingen af Roskilde Universitets Azure-baserede integrationsplatform. Du skal udvikle integrationer og fælles komponenter samt bidrage til en robust og sammenhængende applikations- og integrationsarkitektur. Samtidig får du mulighed for at fastlægge teamets standarder for kode, unittest og dokumentation inden for vores fælles arkitekturprincipper og i dialog med teamet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med teamets øvrige udviklere, faglig koordinator og testmanager samt med arkitekter, drift og projektledere.

Roskilde Universitet er i gang med en omfattende digital modernisering. Vi udskifter og opgraderer centrale systemer og flytter løbende integrationer til en fælles integrationsplatform. Det stiller krav til robuste API’er, genanvendelige komponenter, sikker dataudveksling og løsninger, der kan overvåges, driftes og videreudvikles.

Om Digital og dit team

Du bliver en del af Digitaliseringsenheden med 16 medarbejdere. Enheden hører under Digital, Roskilde Universitets centrale afdeling for IT, digitalisering, informationssikkerhed, samt projekt- og procesmetoder. Digital har ca. 70 medarbejdere.

Din daglige base bliver udviklingsteamet, som består af fem udviklere, en fagkoordinator samt en testmanager. Teamet deltager i udviklingsprojekter og varetager samtidig den løbende vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af universitetets systemer, integrationer og platforme.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine hovedopgaver i jobbet er at: Udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer, fælles komponenter og referenceimplementeringer på vores integrationsplatform.
Omsætte behov, krav og arkitekturprincipper til tekniske designs og robuste løsninger samt videreudvikle principperne for udviklingsområdet i samarbejde med teamet og arkitekterne.
Fastlægge og forankre teamets udviklingsprincipper og standarder samt løfte den tekniske kvalitet gennem code reviews, automatiseret test, dokumentation, faglig sparring og videndeling.
Videreudvikle vores CI/CD-pipelines og automatisere build, test og deployment.
Bidrage gennem hele DevOps-forløbet fra analyse og udvikling til idriftsættelse, overvågning og fejlhåndtering.
Anvende og videreudvikle teamets brug af AI-baserede udviklingsværktøjer til kodning, test, dokumentation og fejlsøgning.

Kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT, softwareudvikling eller lignende. Du kan også have opbygget tilsvarende kompetencer gennem flere års relevant erhvervserfaring.
Vi forventer at du har: Solid erfaring med C#, moderne .NET og objektorienteret softwareudvikling.
Erfaring med design, udvikling og deployment af integrationer i Azure, gerne med Azure Functions og App Service.
Erfaring med API’er, dataflows og datakontrakter samt databaser, SQL, JSON og XML.
Erfaring med Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD-pipelines og automatiserede unit- og integrationstest.
Evne til at omsætte krav og arkitekturprincipper til robuste løsninger, begrunde tekniske valg og dokumentere kode, snitflader og tekniske beslutninger.
Erfaring med AI-understøttet softwareudvikling og evne til at kvalitetssikre værktøjernes kode og forslag.
Lyst til at dele viden og løfte den tekniske kvalitet sammen med resten af teamet.
Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder
Eventbaserede integrationer og robuste meddelelsesmønstre, herunder idempotens.
Containerbaserede løsninger og IAC, f.eks. Docker eller Terraform,
Identitets- og adgangsstyring i Azure, herunder Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault eller OAuth 2.0.
Entity Framework, GraphQL

Vi lægger vægt på, at du arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan sætte dig ind i komplekse tekniske problemstillinger. Du samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af fagligheder og kan forklare tekniske valg til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger. Du skal kunne formulere dig på dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten med indplacering efter gældende overenskomst som specialkonsulent eller anden relevant overenskomst. Der er herudover mulighed for at forhandle tillæg. Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med ansættelse 1. december eller snarest herefter.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 43 og 44.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til enhedschef Sonni Hansen på +45 6195 1227 eller sonni@ruc.dk.

Jf. direktivet om løngennemsigtighed fremgår lønintervallerne for de forskellige jobkategorier på Roskilde Universitet her.

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

Ansøgningsfristen er 14. oktober2026.

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description:
Du bliver en del af Professional Services (PS) – vores forretningsenhed, der arbejder med digitalisering og teknologiske løsninger inden for ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, Business Intelligence, Cyber Consultancy, Custom Built Solutions og AI.

I forretningsområdet Custom Built Solutions vil du indgå i vores Products-team, der udvikler og driver Danmarks førende elektroniske patientjournalsystem til den kommunale tandpleje. Vi søger en full-stack Developer med særligt fokus på frontend-udvikling. Samtidig skal du blive motiveret af at arbejde med videreudvikling og forbedring af et veletableret system, som hver dag understøtter arbejdet i den kommunale tandpleje i samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer.

Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Viby eller Nordhavn med mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Du kan dog forvente periodisk mødeaktivitet på begge lokationer.

Din rolle

Som Developer kommer du til at arbejde med videreudvikling og vedligeholdelse af vores system til den kommunale tandpleje. Rollen har primært fokus på frontend-udvikling og integrationer til øvrige systemer, men du kommer også til at være involveret i prioritering af produktudvikling, test, fejlsøgning og dokumentation sammen med resten af det stærke team omkring produktet. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet bl.a. bestående af produktkonsulenter, supportere og andre udviklere, hvor alle har et stærkt ønske om at forbedre og styrke systemets funktionaliteter og sikre glade kunder. Vi løfter i fællesskab, og derfor er det væsentligt, at du er en holdspiller.

Derudover kan rollen også indebære dialog og sparring med kunder – både over for tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i rollen som sparringspartner og kan omsætte og formidle tekniske løsninger i et sprog, der giver mening for brugerne og for dine kollegaer i teamet.

Dine primære ansvarsområder dækker over følgende:

Afdække kundernes forretningsbehov og omsætte dem til tekniske løsninger og systemfunktioner.
Fejlsøge og forbedre eksisterende integrationer for at sikre stabil dataudveksling.
Udvikle nye frontend-funktioner til systemet.
Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende kodebase for at sikre stabil drift og høj performance.
Bidrage til teknisk sparring i forbindelse med design af nye funktioner.
Udarbejde og gennemføre tests af nye funktioner og integrationer.
Udarbejde teknisk dokumentation af nye funktioner, integrationer og systemændringer.

Vi søger en teamm8 der

Ønsker en rolle med fokus på både nyudvikling og vedligeholdelse af et anerkendt system inden for et nicheområde. Derudover ser vi gerne at følgende er opfyldt:

3-5 års erfaring fra en rolle som udvikler særligt med fokus på frontend-udvikling, hvor du eventuelt har arbejdet med Middleware, Unit-testing og/eller CI/CD.
Gerne viden om WinForms, .Net Framework/.Net Core, SQL Server, Git og/eller Azure DevOps.
Evner at forklare kompleks kode i et sprog som kollegaer og kunder forstår.
Motiveres i kundedialoger og behovsafdækning, som herefter omsættes til konkrete løsninger.
Behersker dansk og engelsk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Det du får

En unik mulighed for at arbejde med softwareudvikling i et nichesystem, der er anerkendt i markedet.
Mulighed for tage ansvar i en udviklingsrolle af teknisk karakter, hvor du formår at spille systemets brugere gode med rette rådgivning.
At blive en del af en hybrid arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde.
Indgå i en kultur med ambitioner, ærlighed og plads til personlig udvikling
At blive en del af en ambitiøs IT-koncern med 1600 teamm8s, der hepper på dig.

Skal du med på holdet?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Stefanie Kerstin Krüger Holtum, Manager - Custom Built Solutions på skkru@itm8.com. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter straffeattest forud for ansættelse.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Om itm8

Vi er itm8 – vores kunders IT-mate.

Bag os står 1.600+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Med specialister inden for alt fra IT-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.

Men det, der binder os sammen, er ikke kun teknologi. Det er PURPLE POWER – vores måde at arbejde på. Her hjælper vi hinanden først, fejrer det der virker, og skærer igennem bullshit. Vi tror på ambition frem for status quo. Og på at forskellighed gør os stærkere.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være perfekt. Men om at tage ansvar, skabe værdi og udvikle sig – hver dag.

Så spørg dig selv: Hvad kan du bygge i dag? Hvor kan det tage os i morgen?

Lyder det som dig? Så søg – og bliv vores næste team'm8.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Innovation & Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join BEUMER Group Innovation & Development in creating solutions that power the next level of logistic sortation systems worldwide. As a Robotics Software Engineer at BEUMER Group, you’ll design innovative solutions that drive efficiency and reliability in sortation and handling systems for logistic sites around the globe.

Our logistics customers seek innovative solutions to improve the efficiency of their sites. The team operates in a global setup and collaborates closely with colleagues across locations and disciplines. The team's mission is to develop innovative products and systems for the logistics industry.

Develop, maintain, and debug software on industrial PCs and robotic platforms, including communication and computer vision applications.
Configure, program, and integrate industrial robots and motion control systems.
Work with geometric and spatial calculations related to robot motion, object positioning, and vision-guided applications.
Participate in the development of new products, from early prototypes to market-ready solutions.
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across disciplines and locations in a global organization.

Driving business value

You Bring The Following Qualifications To The Role

A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience with robotics and automation technologies, preferably from a similar or related industry.
Experience developing near real-time software and solid knowledge of C#. Experience with Python, Docker, and microservice architecture is an advantage.
Interest in robotics software and technologies, particularly in combination with computer vision applications.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment.
Strong understanding of geometry and spatial reasoning, including the ability to model and calculate physical dimensions, positions, and movements in real-world systems.

Want to know more?

Interested?

BEUMER Group

jobs.title: DevOps-medarbejder til .NET løsninger
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med IT i en styrelse, der arbejder med hele fødevarekæden fra jord til bord under politisk og mediemæssig bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle og vedligeholde styrelsens It- og forretningssystemer og bidrage til at sikre brugervenlige og sammenhængende digitale løsninger samt effektive arbejdsgange? Vil du være en del af vores digitale transformation og arbejde efter agile metoder? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i IT-systemvedligehold og drift i Fødevarestyrelsen.

Fødevarestyrelsen søger en DevOps-medarbejder med erfaring og kompetencer inden for Azure-miljøet til IT-enheden, hvor man kommer til at stå midt i en spændende udvikling hen imod en moderne IT-platform i tæt samarbejde mellem udvikling og drift.

Vores digitale transformation er i gang

Fødevarestyrelsen skal med brugernes behov i centrum videreudvikle og forny IT-understøttelsen af en stor del af vores kerneforretning. Derfor står vi midt i et spændende og udfordrende forløb, som du vil blive en del af.

Som et led i dette, har vi et stigende behov for at forbedre vores arbejdsgange omkring løbende udvikling og idriftsættelse. Vi har både nyere og ældre applikationer, og har både behov for at få løftet driften af de ældre løsninger, men også behov for løbende at idriftsætte og udvikle nye løsninger.

Du kommer til at være et teknisk bindeled imellem IT-enhedens drifts- og udviklingsteams. Sammen med andre kollegaer vil du sørge for, at applikationer løbende udvikles, deployeres og patches.

Om jobbet

Som DevOps-medarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre stabile driftsløsninger og understøtte den fortsatte udvikling af styrelsens IT-landskab. Du bliver det tekniske bindeled mellem drift og udvikling og får en central rolle i vores Azure-miljø.

Du vil således både indgå i den daglige drift men også i de agile arbejdsgange omkring nye it-leverancer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at: Drift, overvågning og vedligeholdelse af styrelsens IT-systemer
Automatisere drifts- og deployeringsprocesser
Samarbejde tæt med udviklere og leverandører om idriftsættelse og vedligeholdelse af løsninger
Fejlsøge, dokumentere og indgå i beredskabsopgaver efter behov
Bidrage til IT-sikkerhed, compliance og stabile driftsprocesser
Være IT-driftens ankerperson på Azure-miljøet

Om dig – vores nye kollega

Vi søger en ny kollega med solid teknologiforståelse og som har erfaring med: Azure DevOps og Azure Pipelines
Har erfaring med it-drift, særligt i relation til DevOps
CI/CD og automatisering af deployments
Drift og administration af Azure-miljøer

Vi lægger derudover vægt på, at du: Er nysgerrig på ny teknologi og gerne vil dele viden – både når du skal modtage og give videre
Har erfaring med systemadministration af større enterprice løsninger.
Trives med bredt ansvar og varierende opgaver
Har godt kendskab til forskellige deployværktøjer
Arbejder struktureret, og har forståelse for drift i en offentlig/statslig kontekst
har erfaring med SCRUM, agile og SAFe.
Har en uddannelse som f.eks. datamatatiker, itteknolog, datalog eller ingeniør – men vi er åbne over for en anden faglig baggrund

Kendskab til disse teknologier er en fordel:
Microsoft .NET Core, Microsoft IIS, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft Server, Microsoft EntraID og tenant administration.
Grafana

Om Fødevarestyrelsens IT

IT-enheden består af tre sektioner, der arbejder tæt sammen. Samlet set er vi ca. 45 medarbejdere. Stillingen er placeret i IT-systemvedligehold og -drift, som består af 17 medarbejdere. Vi samarbejder tæt med Statens IT, hvilket giver mulighed for at udvikle kompetencer inden for leverandørstyring. Vi stræber efter at opretholde en høj faglig standard, som gør det muligt for os at udfordre vores leverandører gennem en solid IT-faglig dialog.

Fordele og goder

Vi tilbyder fleksible arbejdstider, mulighed for hjemmearbejde, efteruddannelse og deltagelse i sociale arrangementer. Vi har et stærkt fokus på medarbejdertrivsel og arbejder i et innovativt og samarbejdsorienteret miljø.

Udviklingsmuligheder

Der er rig mulighed for karriereudvikling og efteruddannelse inden for organisationen. Vi støtter dine professionelle mål og tilbyder et miljø, hvor du kan vokse og udvikle dig.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker efter relevant statslig overenskomst.

Har du en akademisk uddannelse, vil du blive ansat efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Skatteministeriet og en række AC-organisationer, og du vil som udgangspunkt blive ansat som fuldmægtig.

Afhængig af din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer, kan der ske ansættelse som specialkonsulent.

Har du en ikke-akademisk uddannelse, vil du blive ansat efter den relevante gældende overenskomst.

Ansættelsesområdet er Fødevarestyrelsen, og tjenestestedet er IT-enheden, Stationsparken 31-33, 2600 Glostrup.

Tiltrædelsestidspunkt:

Der er brug for dig snarest muligt og gerne den 1. december 2026.

Din ansøgning

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, CV, kopi af eksamensbevis og andre relevante bilag via vores online rekrutteringssystem senest den 15. oktober 2026.

Vi vil gerne bede om, at du i din ansøgning beskriver:
* Dine erfaringer med DevOps, herunder automatisering, CI/CD-processer og drift af løsninger i Azure.
* Et konkret eksempel på, hvordan du har samarbejdet på tværs af drift og udvikling for at sikre stabile og effektive leverancer.

Vi holder samtaler i løbet af uge 43 på vores adresse i Glostrup.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingsopslaget, er du velkommen til at kontakte den ansvarlige sektionsleder Nicolai på 72 27 68 08.

Læs mere om at arbejde i Fødevarestyrelsen på www.fvst.dk/job.

Det er en betingelse for ansættelsen, at du som led i din ansættelse, kan:
* Opnå gyldig arbejds- opholdstilladelse i Danmark inden tiltrædelse eller
* Opnå gyldigt opholdsdokument i Danmark ved ansættelse.

Fødevarestyrelsen betragter mangfoldighed som et aktiv og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Do you feel like the tools that make a game are more interesting than the game itself?

As our new Senior Unity Tools Developer, you’ll join our Core Tech team building and maintaining the shared tools and packages that power everything we make, from hands and cars to horses and beyond.

Your focus will be on making great internal tools: creating solid, well-documented packages, improving our testing and automation setup, and jumping in when Unity issues need debugging.

Here’s what your job looks like day to day

Building and maintaining Unity tools like automation, localization, or game data (with great documentation and a strong “others will use this” mindset)
Helping debug and troubleshoot issues in Unity (editor and runtime)
Collaborating with other team members on new packages
Improving the overall game development experience for everyone through better workflows, reliability, and clarity in our shared tools

Must-haves

Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of Unity tooling, including its asset pipeline
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and CloudKit, using Xcode and Swift
Experience with performance optimization
Strong fundamentals in software design (e.g. unit testing, integration testing, dependency injection, design patterns)
A deep interest in tools development: you get more excited about building tooling and setting up efficient workflows than working directly on player-facing game features
An investigative mindset: you’re curious, thorough, and enjoy getting to the bottom of tricky problems
A genuine interest in sharing knowledge: you enjoy bringing people together, explaining how things work and helping them adopt tools

Nice-to-haves

Experience with automated testing of Unity projects, including on-device testing
Experience with graphics and shaders programming
Interest in experimenting with and using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) in your day-to-day

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.
You're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.
You value a positive work environment and contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place.
You have team production experiences, such as using version control software (we use git), branching, stand-ups, sprints, and reviews.

Practicalities

We don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.
No crunch. People over deadlines.
Our working language is English.

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.
Pension plan and private health insurance.
Endless amounts of coffee.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

jobs.title: Senior CI/CD Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly-skilled Senior CI/CD Engineer based in Asia to make our builds faster, our pipelines more reliable, and our automated testing part of every change. You will focus on build performance for our C#/.NET and C++ software and on bringing tests and static analysis into CI. You will work closely with development, verification, our test architect and IT-DevOps teams in Europe and Asia.
Today, a full end-to-end pipeline runs around 200 jobs and over 10,000 automated tests and takes about 4 hours. Your main goal is to cut that time significantly (we aim for around 50% in your first year) while giving developers fast, reliable feedback on every merge request. This is a hands-on CI/CD role inside engineering, not an infrastructure DevOps role. You will spend most of your time optimising builds and pipelines, and a smaller share keeping them running.
Key Initiatives:

Reduce Pipeline Time:
Map the critical path, remove waiting between jobs, cut per-job overhead (clone, artifact download, restore) and cancel redundant pipelines automatically.
Job Strategy:
Decide what runs where and when: fast merge request checks, fuller runs on main and release branches, and complete nightly runs. Group short jobs, split long ones and parallelise long system test suites.
Tests in the Pipeline:
With the test architect, place each test type in the right pipeline tier, select tests by change where safe, quarantine flaky tests and move coverage runs to scheduled pipelines.
Release Pipelines:
Make release and cherry-pick pipelines fast and predictable so fixes reach customers quickly.

Key Responsibilities:

Build Performance:
Profile and optimise MSBuild-based builds for C#/.NET Framework 4.7 and C++: incremental and parallel builds, NuGet and dependency caching, and removal of bottlenecks.
Pipeline Design:
Design, standardise and maintain reusable GitLab CI pipeline templates (.gitlab-ci.yml, DAGs, multi-project pipelines) across C#, C++ and Python repositories.
Test & Verification Integration:
With the test architect, development and QA/verification leads, embed unit tests, static analysis (Coverity, SonarQube) and automated test bench runs into CI, with clear results reporting. Agree jointly with the test architect which suites run in each pipeline tier.
Pipeline Reliability & Metrics:
Investigate failures, remove flaky builds and tests, and track build time, failure rate and pipeline uptime on dashboards to show improvement.
Pipeline Operations:
Act as first line on the engineering side when pipelines or runners go down: diagnose, restart or re-run jobs, unblock developers, and hand infrastructure issues to IT-DevOps with a clear diagnosis.
Capacity Input:
Give IT-DevOps data-backed requirements for build runners and test environments, based on queue times and job durations.
Artifact & Release Automation:
Automate versioning, release packaging, artifact staging and package registry management.
Developer Workflow:
Advise teams on branching and merge strategies, merge request verification gates and fast feedback loops.

Scope

GitLab runner management, AWS/cloud infrastructure and GitLab platform administration are owned by the IT-DevOps team. This role works with them on requirements and issues but does not own that infrastructure. It is their engineering-side point of contact: first line when pipelines are down, and input on sizing what we need.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or relevant discipline.
At least 5+ years in CI/CD, build engineering or release automation for multi-repository C#/.NET and C++ codebases.
Deep hands-on experience with MSBuild and .NET Framework 4.x builds on Windows; experience with C++ builds (MSBuild/CMake).
CI/CD Platform:
Strong GitLab CI/CD skills: pipeline authoring, DAGs, multi-project pipelines, caching and artifact management.
Scripting:
Strong PowerShell and Python for pipeline logic, build orchestration and log analysis; our build also includes Python-based simulation.
Test Execution in CI:
Experience splitting, grouping and parallelising long-running test suites, and detecting and managing flaky tests.
Containers:
Working knowledge of Docker for build and test jobs.
Problem-Solving & Communication:
Able to root-cause complex build, link and test integration failures.
Fluent English for working across regions.

Preferred/ Good to Have:

Experience in semiconductor equipment, high-tech machine automation, or hardware/software integration environments.
Hands-on use of Coverity, SonarQube and test management tools (Xray, Jira).
Experience with build acceleration or distributed build tools.
Experience migrating old-style .csproj projects to SDK-style.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT - 2 Years)

THE TEAM & THE JOB

The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.

As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long-term platform evolution.

What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
Design and architect end-to-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
Make high-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
Lead complex, enterprise-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post-go-live support.
Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.

jobs.title: Solution Architect (NA Time Zone)
jobs.description:
We are
invent.ai

invent.ai is a fast-growing company providing AI-Decisioning for Inventory, Merchandising and Pricing Optimization Solutions to retailers around the world. This is an exciting time at Invent, as we are growing our client base, our product portfolio, and our teams to revolutionize the supply chain planning industry.

We are a group of bright, kind, and goal-oriented people working together to make retail better. We take pride in what we do. As a provider of award-winning enterprise-AI SaaS solutions that serve a growing international business with customers across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia, we make a measurable and meaningful difference for our customers every day.

Headquartered in the United States and with offices around the world, our team of 350+ people consists of young engineers and data scientists from the top CS and engineering programs working remotely out of our Istanbul, Philadelphia, Amsterdam, and London offices.

For more information, visit www.invent.ai

About Role

We are seeking a Solution Architect
to join our Delivery organization and take on a strategic role that strengthens our project delivery capabilities. The role is critical for ensuring scalable, cost-efficient, and high-quality implementations of Invent.ai solutions. Solution Architects act as technical leaders across pre-, during, and post-delivery phases, helping increase project throughput, improve architectural rigor, and support broader operational excellence.

What You Will Do

Serve as the primary technical point of contact in delivery projects: design, review, and lead scalable solution implementations across client engagements.
Post-delivery, provide structured support to the Client Excellence team via dedicated Architect Task Clinics to troubleshoot, optimize, and scale client-facing solutions.
Understand business and data requirements and translate them into technical solution designs, data flows, integrations, and high-level architectures.
Participate in and facilitate customer-facing data workshops and design meetings, guiding discussions toward clear and actionable outcomes.
Engage with customers to understand and clarify their data requirements, existing data structures, business needs, and technical constraints.
Present and explain our data structures, data models, integration approaches, and platform capabilities, helping customers understand how their requirements can be addressed.
Identify gaps between customer requirements and existing data structures or capabilities, and collaboratively shape, refine, or adapt solutions to address them.
Translate agreed customer requirements into data structures, mappings, data flows, integration requirements, and solution designs.
Produce architecture diagrams and supporting technical documentation to clearly communicate proposed solutions.
Evaluate solution options and articulate technical trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and design considerations.
Apply established architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.
Support architecture assessments and design decisions, and help ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with the agreed architecture and design.
Partner with the Center of Excellence to develop and maintain best practices and reusable assets that improve delivery efficiency and enable scalable knowledge transfer across teams.

Experience

What We Are Looking For

5+ years in data engineering, software engineering, technology consulting, solution design, or a related technical role
3+ years of domain expertise in Retail, Merchandising, or Supply Chain Planning, ideally across multiple implementations
Proven track record in customer-facing roles
Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AI/ML or analytics solutions

Skill Set Required

Solid understanding of data architectures and platforms — data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and system integrations
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cost optimization strategies
Understanding of architecture principles: scalability, availability, security, performance, and maintainability
Ability to translate business requirements into structured technical requirements and solution designs
Ability to create, document, and communicate technical/architecture diagrams, using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io, Miro, or similar (plus general proficiency with Office/Google productivity tools)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify gaps and propose practical solutions
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and executive/non-technical stakeholders
Good command of business English
Willingness and availability to work North American business hours at least 3 days per week

AI Maturity Framework

We evaluate and develop everyone against a four-level AI maturity framework:

L0 — Transactional
: Uses ChatGPT/Gemini only as a search engine. Not the level we hire at.

L1 — Copilot / Augmented
: Uses AI to draft e-mails / partial slides but not multi-step delivery workflows.

L2 — Agentic Development
: Delegates multi-step tasks to AI agents; automates status reports; triages runs with Claude + SQL; validates outputs before sending. Our standard target.

L3 — Spec-Driven
: Orchestrates an end-to-end implementation engine: discovery → config → runs → QA → comms via AI. Owns 2+ internal skills / plugins used by peers.

AI-First Requirements

At Invent.ai we run AI-augmented delivery. This role requires a professional who has built AI-driven workflows that compress implementation cycles — not someone who only "chats with AI” You will operate at AI Maturity Level L2+ minimum (Agentic Development) from Day 1.

You Must Bring a Track Record Of

Orchestrating multi-step agentic workflows across project management, communication and data tools — Claude skills, MCP connectors, Cursor, Gemini — to automate status reporting, risk tracking, meeting follow-ups and customer updates;
Building and maintaining your own prompt library and at least two custom skills, plugins or internal agents for recurring delivery tasks;
Running a rigorous Human-in-the-Loop validation process on every AI-generated artefact that reaches a customer.

“I use Cursor” or ”I use ChatGPT” is not a sufficient answer. You will be asked which AI tools and workflows you added to your delivery stack in the last 30 days — and the 30 days before that — and how they changed your team’s output.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to support the design of scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions across our data ecosystem.

The role will work closely with Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Platform teams, Delivery Managers and business stakeholders to translate business and data requirements into implementable solution designs.

Life At Invent.ai

Join great teammates across the globe: We consider ourselves anything but average!
We love what we do: Our team has an exciting tech stack; Pyspark, Databricks, Python, and so on
We work flexibly and remotely: Instead of spending time in traffic, we can spend this time with ourselves and our loved ones,
Flat organization with a very strong entrepreneurial culture,
We provide monthly fixed contribution to internet bill and fun packets (Netflix, Amazon Prime etc.)
We care about your health and support it with comprehensive private health insurance
We support your career growth with Udemy, Medium, HBR and other learning tools
At Invent.ai, you have extra off days for different occasions (birthday, moving day, maternity & paternity leaves etc.)
Great people make the perfect match: We have a powerful referral bonus for the friend you refer, bring to buddy!
Work hard, play harder, unlimited fun at work: All-day snacks at the office, team activities, social club meetings, annual retreats, monthly happy Friday drinks and other celebrations. Also, we love gaming and so have a Game Master at Invent! (We really mean it when we say we love it!)
At Invent.ai we celebrate and reward our successful teammates who have won awards in arts and sports!
We care about social responsibility and that's why we have a community! Invent.ai gives you the opportunity to make a real difference in people's lives. Our Invent Social Responsibility Club works for educational scholarships and donations, supports young talents by sponsoring them, raises money by running on behalf of non-governmental organizations in marathons etc.
We believe that we will be more productive when we achieve our work-life balance. We support the Invent social clubs for their hobbies; painting, tennis, football and more!

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Invent.ai provides equal employment opportunities, and we strive for a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are together without discrimination of nationality, gender, belief, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation. For us, diversity means embracing all the features that make us unique.

Corporate Social Responsibility

Working at Invent.ai gives you an opportunity to make a difference in people’s lives. Invent Social Responsibility Club activities include;

Grants scholarships at four different educational institutions
An Earthquake fund where Invent matches employee donations 1:1 for underprivileged students

Invent the Future with Us

Does this sound like your next dream job? Let's get you started!

We look forward to meeting you!

https://www.invent.ai/privacy-policy

As Associate Director, R&D Software Engineering, you will be accountable for the end‑to‑end software development function, including architecture, development, testing, and release management, for products operating within a regulated healthcare context. This role provides leadership across multiple development teams, balancing the sustainment of validated products with the delivery of new initiatives, while ensuring quality, compliance, and scalability are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.

You will combine strong technical depth with disciplined execution and people leadership, and you will be comfortable operating in environments where regulatory compliance, documentation, and audit‑readiness are as critical as delivery speed. Partnering closely across Product, Quality, and Operations, you will help ensure Clario’s technology continues to meet global regulatory expectations while enabling innovation.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation
Leadership opportunities within a global healthcare technology organization

What You’ll Be Doing

Define and execute the technical and management strategy, including budgeting, to sustain existing software products and deliver new product initiatives in collaboration with senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Partner with Product Management to translate product requirements into delivery plans within an Agile development framework, establishing clear milestones and ensuring delivery on time and within budget.
Monitor progress against plans, document outcomes, and report variances in scope, timeline, cost, or quality.
Foster close collaboration between Software Development and Software Quality Engineering to maximize test automation and distribute integration responsibilities throughout the development lifecycle.
Own development team capacity planning and manage variations in productivity, quality, unplanned work, and remaining effort against planned velocity.
Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Service Delivery, and Product Management to ensure effective communication and documentation for customers, corporate leadership, and validation purposes.
Serve as a member of the Engineering senior management team and the broader corporate management team, contributing to the definition of corporate strategy and long‑term goals.
Proactively identify technical and delivery risks, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure development metrics are maintained and monitored in corporate systems.
Partner with Human Resources to attract, retain, and develop top talent, including interviewing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
Lead organizational development, change management, leadership development, diversity, and continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering organization.
Build and sustain high‑performing teams with a mindset of continuous improvement and adaptability to change.

What We Look For

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive experience (10+ years) in software development within the medical device industry, or within another highly regulated, global industry (such as life sciences, diagnostics, clinical technology, or regulated SaaS).
Demonstrable experience leading software teams delivering products subject to regulatory requirements, including validated development processes, documentation standards, controlled releases, and audit readiness.
Proven senior people leadership experience, managing development organizations of 10+ engineers across multiple levels, disciplines, and technologies.
Strong understanding of Agile development practices as applied in regulated environments, balancing flexibility with compliance and governance requirements.
Deep knowledge of modern software architecture, including multi‑tier systems, multi‑tenant SaaS, performance, reliability, scalability, and data integrity considerations.
Solid understanding of data modeling, process modeling, and database design in enterprise and regulated contexts.
Experience developing and managing budgets, business cases, and cost‑benefit analyses for complex software portfolios.
A consistent track record of managing scope, mitigating delivery and compliance risks, and delivering complex initiatives on time and within budget.

It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description:
New software product team - Automation Edge Applications

The role

At Everllence Automation Edge Applications, we are establishing a new software product team in Piraeus, Greece. You will work closely with colleagues in Denmark and engage with customers across Greece and the Mediterranean region.
The team's mission is to develop customer-facing applications that help vessel crews and shipping companies operate and optimize engine performance more efficiently.

As a Full Stack Software Developer
, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining applications that support vessel crews in operating, monitoring, and optimizing engine performance. You will work closely with UX researchers, data specialists, engine experts, and fellow developers to transform customer needs and operational insights into reliable, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape a newly established product team while benefiting from the support, expertise, and stability of a global engineering organization.

What you will be doing

Design and build customer-facing applications that improve troubleshooting and help vessel crews operate engines effectively.
Develop end-to-end features using C# or Python on the backend and Node.js, React, and our QUILT application framework on the frontend.
Turn input from users, UX research, and engine specialists into well-defined technical solutions and iterative product releases.
Define maintainable application architectures, APIs, data flows, and reusable user interface components.
Design software for the realities of onboard environments, including intermittent connectivity, limited computing resources, and software that cannot always be updated immediately.
Build quality into products through automated testing, code reviews, secure development practices, and useful diagnostics.
Own features throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in collaboration with colleagues across locations.
Collaborate closely with UX researchers, data scientists, domain experts, and fellow developers throughout the product development lifecycle.
Utilize AI-assisted development tools and emerging technologies where they create value while maintaining accountability for software quality, security, and reliability.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic software developer who enjoys turning complex operational requirements into simple, dependable solutions for end users.

Ideally, You Bring

Professional experience delivering full stack web applications and taking features from idea to production.
Strong skills in C#, Python, TypeScript, or similar technologies, with experience in modern backend development.
Experience working with Node.js and React or comparable frontend frameworks.
Experience designing APIs, integrating data sources, and working with version control and continuous integration practices.
Experience with containerization such as Docker.
A quality-focused approach that includes automated testing, maintainability, security, observability, and production support.
The ability to explain technical trade-offs and collaborate effectively with UX researchers, domain specialists, and fellow developers.
Experience within maritime, industrial, manufacturing, energy, edge-computing, or other operational environments is considered an advantage, but not required.
Proficiency in English language.

You are curious, constructive, and comfortable working in a newly established team where priorities may evolve as we learn from customers. You balance speed with sound engineering judgment and understand that software used aboard a vessel must be reliable, secure, and supportable.

Benefits & Learning Opportunities

Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 2-3 days per week after the initial onboarding period of three months, subject to manager agreement and business requirements.
Attractive compensation package
Continuous training opportunities
Work in a challenging multinational environment
Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

Welcome to Everllence Greece and the Automation Edge Application Team

You will be joining our Automation Edge Applications team, consisting of 21 colleagues, including software developers, engineers, designers, and product managers. The team is responsible for designing and developing the digital products used by vessel crews when operating and optimizing our engines.
The team is primarily located in Denmark and works closely with an additional team of 12 colleagues based in India.
The Automation Edge Applications team is part of the Automation function within Everllence R&D, an organization of approximately 160 professionals responsible for the electronic control systems of our engines.
You will be based in our established hub in Piraeus, Greece, and become part of the local Software Engineering organization, where colleagues contribute to a variety of global software and digitalization initiatives across Everllence.
While your day-to-day work will be closely connected to the international Edge Applications team, you will also benefit from being part of a local engineering community and collaborating with professionals across the Piraeus site.

About The Team's Mission

The team is focused on creating customer value by combining user research, customer insights, data-driven analysis, and software development.

Ons team

Met een sterk uitgebouwd IT-team van meer dan 180 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan innovatieve oplossingen. Onze kracht? Een strategisch intern ontwikkeld Core Banking systeem dat onze klanten volledig ontzorgt op vlak van vermogensbeheer en -planning.

Jouw rol

Als Fullstack Developer werk je binnen het Core Banking domein aan applicaties die de kernprocessen van de bank ondersteunen. Denk aan systemen voor betalingsverkeer, effectenadministratie, boekhouding en andere kritische backoffice‑toepassingen.

Jouw werk heeft een directe impact op de stabiliteit, betrouwbaarheid en correctheid van onze dienstverlening, in een sterk gereguleerde omgeving.

Je focus ligt voor 80% op back‑end ontwikkeling en 20% op front‑end.
Je bouwt mee aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, maar draagt ook actief bij aan het onderhoud, de modernisering en de verdere evolutie van bestaande systemen.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen IT en met interne stakeholders, zoals operations en andere business‑teams, om oplossingen te realiseren die zowel technisch robuust als functioneel correct zijn.
Daarnaast denk je mee na over hoe AI kan bijdragen aan efficiëntere ontwikkeling en slimmere applicaties binnen het Core Banking domein.

Daarnaast speel je een rol in:

Het vertalen van regelgeving en businessnoden naar concrete software‑oplossingen
Het verbeteren van bestaande applicaties en processen, met oog voor kwaliteit en efficiëntie
Het garanderen van continuïteit en stabiliteit van systemen die essentieel zijn voor de dagelijkse werking van de bank

Wat we van jou verwachten

Je bent iemand die initiatief neemt, graag meedenkt over oplossingen, mogelijke oplossingen ziet in problemen en die actief in het gesprek brengt.
Je bent flexibel, leergierig en houdt ervan om technologieën snel onder de knie te krijgen.

Technische skills

C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core)
SQL (bij voorkeur SQL Server, Entity Framework)
TypeScript en Angular
Unit & integration testing
Microservices, High Availability, Loosely Coupled Architectures
Message queues, Distributed System patterns
Focus op betrouwbare, schaalbare en onderhoudbare oplossingen binnen een enterprise context

Git
Azure DevOps
ArgoCD/gitops, Kustomize
Docker, Kubernetes
IdentityServer
Elastic Stack
RabbitMQ, NServiceBus
Redis, RavenDB
BPMN of workflow engines zoals Camunda
Domain Driven Design
Ervaring met AI-ondersteunde developmenttools of AI-integraties in applicaties

Praktisch

Contract van onbepaalde duur.
Bij Delen Private Bank geloven we dat aanwezigheid op kantoor bijdraagt aan sterke samenwerking en betrokkenheid. Je werkt dagelijks vanuit ons kantoor in Antwerpen, met ruimte voor ad-hoc uitzonderingen wanneer nodig.

Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden:
je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en tandzorgverzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget.

jouw groei staat centraal. We luisteren naar je ambities en helpen je actief om stappen te zetten binnen onze organisatie. Via opleidingen, interne mobiliteit en intrapreneurship krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan. Jij bent de architect van je loopbaan – wij zorgen voor de juiste ondersteuning.

samenwerken zit in ons DNA. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar collega’s elkaar ondersteunen, kennis delen en elkaar motiveren. We werken in een open en toegankelijke sfeer aan gedeelde doelen – met succes én met ruimte voor humor.

we bouwen aan relaties voor de lange termijn – met onze klanten én onze medewerkers. Ons zeer laag personeelsverloop is daar het bewijs van. Dankzij een cultuur van vertrouwen, open communicatie en stabiliteit krijg je de kans om samen met ons te groeien.

Ervaring binnen een snelgroeiende SaaS-omgeving.

Eindejaarspremie en jaarlijkse bonus

jobs.description:
Werkomgeving

Het Nationaal Instituut voor Criminalistiek en Criminologie of kortweg het NICC is een federale wetenschappelijke instelling binnen de FOD Justitie. Op vraag van de gerechtelijke overheden verrichten ze onafhankelijk onderzoek.

De directie Criminalistiek identificeert en analyseert sporen van verdachten en modus operandi. Zo helpen we daders van misdrijven op te sporen en bewijslast op te bouwen. De directie Criminologie onderzoekt hoe het strafrechtelijke systeem functioneert en hoe we het kunnen verbeteren.

Taakomschrijving

De persoon zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het opzetten en ontwikkelen van applicaties voor onze verschillende wetenschappelijke laboratoria. Deze applicaties hebben betrekking op domeinen zoals drugs, toxicologie, ballistiek, DNA-analyse en criminologisch onderzoek. De kandidaat zal zich engageren vanuit een langetermijnperspectief en zal op termijn de back-up worden van ons Head of Development.

De kandidaat zal instaan voor het verzamelen van de behoeften en aanvragen van onze klanten en zal toezien op de correcte naleving van de deadlines van de projecten waarvoor hij/zij verantwoordelijk is.
Hij/zij zal instaan voor het onderhoud van de applicaties en zal daarnaast proactief meedenken en voorstellen formuleren ter ondersteuning van het IT-team.
Hij/zij zal eveneens toezien op de naleving van de vereisten inzake applicatiearchitectuur en veiligheid.
In bepaalde gevallen zal hij/zij externe teams aansturen die ondersteuning bieden bij de uitvoering van de projecten. In dat kader zal de kandidaat, afhankelijk van zijn/haar senioriteitsniveau (meer dan 5 jaar ervaring), ook instaan voor het interviewen en selecteren van externe medewerkers.

Profielomschrijving:

Een ervaren ontwikkelaar die AI gebruikt, moet diepgaande technische expertise combineren met het vermogen om AI-tools te orkestreren, methodologische nauwkeurigheid en geavanceerde ontwerpvaardigheden. De kern van het profiel: een pragmatische architect, prompt engineer, integrator en bewaker van kwaliteit.

Fundamentele technische competenties:

Programmeertalen & frameworks

Beheersing van een moderne backendprogrammeertaal: Python, C#, Java, Go, Node.js.
Beheersing van een frontendframework: React, Vue, Angular. Cloudarchitectuur: Azure, AWS, GCP.
Databases: geavanceerde SQL, optimalisatie, NoSQL, vector databases (Pinecone, Redis Vector).

Architectuur & ontwerp

Moderne design patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, Hexagonal Architecture).
Microservices en API's.
Applicatiebeveiliging: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust.
Observability/monitoring: gestructureerde logs, gedistribueerde traces en metrics.

Essentiële AI-competenties:

Geavanceerde prompt engineering

Structureren van prompts (rol → context → beperkingen → outputformaat).
Technieken: chain-of-thought, self-consistency, RAG en prompt guards.
Optimaliseren van de kwaliteit en verminderen van hallucinaties.

Integratie van AI in applicaties

Gebruik van LLM-API's: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic en Mistral
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): vectorisatie, embeddings en pipelines
AI-agents: orkestratie, tools en beveiliging
Fine-tuning: gespecialiseerde modellen en het samenstellen en beheren van datasets

AI-kwaliteit & governance

Evaluatie van modellen (BLEU, ROUGE, perplexity en menselijke evaluatie)
Detectie van bias, robuustheid en conformiteit met regelgeving en standaarden (NIS2, AVG/GDPR)
Implementatie van beveiligings- en controlemechanismen (guardrails, filtering en monitoring)

DevOps- en automatiseringscompetenties

Intelligente automatisering

CI/CD-processen versterkt door AI, zoals het genereren van pipelines, tests en documentatie
AI-ondersteunde refactoring: modernisering van legacycode.
Geautomatiseerde testen: unit tests, integratietesten en mutation testing:

Moderne tools

GitHub Copilot, GitHub en GitLab.
Docker en Kubernetes.

Specifieke competenties van een “AI-augmented” ontwikkelaar

Wat dit profiel werkelijk onderscheidt

Het vermogen om met behulp van AI betrouwbare code te genereren en deze vervolgens te auditen en optimaliseren.
Het creëren van AI-pipelines (prompt → test → verbetering → versionering).
Het gebruik van AI om het ontwerpproces te versnellen, bijvoorbeeld voor diagrammen, modellen en user stories.
Het automatiseren van repetitieve taken, zoals scripts, migraties, testen en documentatie.
Versnelde technologische monitoring: geautomatiseerde samenvattingen en vergelijking van oplossingen.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren: van cybersecurity-uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen ter ondersteuning van nieuwe manieren van werken tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.

Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je tegelijk werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en maximale kansen krijgt om je ambities waar te maken? Dan bieden wij:

Een duidelijke missie in een stimulerende werkomgeving
Een zeer competitief salarispakket met een uitgebreide waaier aan extralegale voordelen, waaronder:
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Maaltijdcheques
Mobiliteitsvoordelen
Pensioenfonds

Daarnaast hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, met telewerkmogelijkheden voor de meeste functies. Onze kantoren zijn bovendien zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.
