jobs.title: Principal Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role

The Evolve programme is accelerating Euroclear’s adoption of public cloud by establishing secure, resilient and scalable foundations, architecture standards and reusable implementation patterns. It brings together architecture, engineering, security, operations and migration stakeholders to enable workloads to move to and operate effectively on Azure in line with Euroclear’s business, risk and regulatory requirements.

As Principal Cloud Architect, you will act as a senior architecture leader for cloud adoption. You will set architecture direction across a broad, cross-organisational scope; help mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority into an effective and sustainable decision-making body; steer cloud foundation priorities; govern architecture artefacts and reference implementations; and provide pragmatic guidance to workload teams.

The role combines strategic architecture leadership, hands-on delivery support and cross-functional decision-making. A key outcome is to expand Euroclear’s cloud presence responsibly by turning cloud strategy and principles into actionable standards, deployable patterns and sound workload decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Solution Design Authority

Mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority by clarifying its mandate, decision rights, intake process, governance, cadence, quality criteria and follow-up of architecture decisions.
Establish a sustainable operating rhythm that enables timely, traceable and risk-informed decisions.
Facilitate complex architecture discussions, document outcomes and ensure that decisions, conditions and actions have clear owners.
Improve the quality and consistency of architecture submissions by providing guidance, templates and early engagement.

Cloud Foundations and Roadmap

Refine, prioritise and maintain the cloud foundation roadmap across identity, connectivity, security, governance, management, operations and automation.
Balance migration demand, risk reduction, platform scalability, technical debt and delivery capacity when setting priorities.
Identify cross-platform dependencies and sequence foundation capabilities so that workload teams can adopt cloud safely and efficiently.
Advise programme and technology leadership on architecture choices, investment priorities and delivery trade-offs.

Architecture Direction and Artefacts

Develop, maintain and govern cloud architecture principles, standards, target-state designs, roadmaps and architecture decision records.
Translate enterprise strategy, regulatory expectations and delivery needs into clear architecture direction.
Ensure cloud architecture remains aligned with enterprise, security, data, resilience and technology standards.
Maintain traceability between strategic objectives, architecture decisions, implementation guidance and delivery outcomes.

Reference Implementations and Reusable Patterns

Prioritise reusable cloud patterns and reference implementations based on workload demand, risk reduction and strategic value.
Guide their delivery so that approved patterns are deployable, testable, automated and consumable by workload teams.
Translate architecture into infrastructure-as-code accelerators, policy-driven guardrails and reusable platform services.
Promote standardisation and governed self-service while limiting manual fulfilment and one-off solutions to justified exceptions.

Workload Assessment and Migration Guidance

Support migration teams and workload owners in assessing application architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability, compatibility and migration readiness.
Recommend appropriate migration or modernisation strategies based on business value, criticality, compliance, lifecycle impact and technical feasibility.
Help teams select the most appropriate service model, considering SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS without assuming that one model is universally optimal.
Identify architecture gaps and convert assessment findings into actionable remediation, sequencing and decision points.

Cloud Footprint and Regional Architecture

Shape the expansion of Euroclear’s cloud footprint, including new-region adoption, regional operating models and multi-region approaches.
Assess implications for foundations, connectivity, identity, security, data residency, resilience, operations, support and cost.
Define architecture guidance for workload placement and regional deployment.
Ensure exceptions to approved regions or patterns have documented rationale, risk assessment, ownership and approval.

Sustainability and Net-Zero Assessment

Assess the cloud implications of sustainability and Net-Zero-related decisions.
Evaluate architecture trade-offs involving region selection, service choices, resource efficiency, carbon considerations, cost, resilience and performance.
Promote efficient use of managed and cloud-native services where they provide measurable value and acceptable risk.
Ensure sustainability considerations are incorporated into architecture decisions and roadmaps without compromising security, regulation or service quality.

Architecture Assurance

Review solution designs and assess alignment with approved principles, standards, target architectures and reference patterns.
Identify material risks, gaps and deviations, and provide clear recommendations to delivery teams and decision-makers.
Ensure exceptions have an explicit rationale, accountable owner, remediation action and expiry or review date.
Track recurring deviations and use them to improve standards, patterns, platform capabilities and governance.

Stakeholder Alignment and Leadership

Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Engineering, CISO, Production, Business Resilience, migration teams, programme leadership and workload owners.
Resolve architectural dependencies and accelerate decisions across organisational boundaries.
Influence senior business and IT stakeholders by making complex trade-offs clear and decision-ready.
Challenge constructively and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.

Architecture Community and Knowledge Transfer

Coach and mentor architects and engineers working on cloud initiatives.
Strengthen the architecture community through knowledge sharing, reviews, reusable guidance and lessons learned.
Ensure cloud standards, patterns and decision processes are understood and applied consistently.
Promote pragmatic, collaborative and outcome-focused ways of working across architecture and delivery teams.

Candidate Profile

Required Experience

Extensive experience as a cloud architect, enterprise architect or principal solution architect in large-scale technology transformation.
Demonstrated experience leading architecture across complex, cross-organisational business and IT scopes.
Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including landing zones, identity and access management, network topology, security, governance, policy, management, observability and platform automation.
Experience establishing or maturing design authorities, architecture review boards, decision processes and architecture assurance practices.
Proven ability to develop and govern principles, standards, target architectures, roadmaps, architecture decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance.
Experience translating architecture into infrastructure-as-code accelerators, reference implementations, guardrails and consumable platform services.
Practical experience assessing workload architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability and compatibility, and recommending migration or modernisation strategies.
Experience designing or governing multi-region cloud environments, including region selection, connectivity, data residency, resilience, operational support and cost trade-offs.
Strong understanding of security by design, policy-driven governance, shared responsibility and risk-proportionate control models.
Experience in financial services, financial market infrastructure or another regulated environment.
Good understanding of ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection and third-party requirements relevant to regulated financial institutions.
Proven ability to align senior stakeholders, facilitate complex decisions and communicate architecture recommendations clearly.
Ability to balance strategic direction, portfolio prioritisation and detailed technical implementation challenges.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex architecture topics clear, actionable and decision-ready.
Experience working in Agile, DevOps or hybrid delivery environments.
Proficiency in English.

Preferred Experience

Experience applying Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and enterprise-scale Azure landing-zone principles.
Experience with cloud-native and managed service adoption across SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS.
Knowledge of application modernisation, integration architecture, APIs, event-driven design, data platforms or container platforms.
Experience with FinOps, cloud cost transparency and continuous optimisation.
Experience assessing cloud sustainability and resource-efficiency implications.
Knowledge of post-trade market infrastructure or comparable critical financial-market environments.
Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as Open Agile Architecture or TOGAF.
Working proficiency in French or Dutch.

Certifications

The Following Certifications Are Valued. Candidates Are Not Expected To Hold All Of Them, But Should Demonstrate Relevant Depth Across Azure Architecture, Security And Enterprise Architecture

Azure Architecture: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
Azure Security: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent.
DevOps and Automation: Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Terraform certification or equivalent infrastructure-as-code accreditation.
Enterprise Architecture: TOGAF, Open Agile Architecture or an equivalent architecture certification.
Security and Risk: CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC or equivalent.
FinOps and Sustainability: FinOps Certified Practitioner or relevant cloud sustainability training.

Please note that this is a permanent position, and we do not offer freelance/contract arrangement for the role
.

In order to cultivate relationships and promote team spirit, we require your presence in the office for a minimum of 8 days per month.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). jobs.title: Software Engineer: Keystone Project (Machine-Verified LLM Inference)
jobs.description:
Mission

The Keystone project, an ARIA-funded collaboration between EPFL and Imperial College London, aims to build a formally-verified ML inference engine, demonstrating that AI can help make verified systems competitive with unverified systems in terms of development effort, features, and performance. Its missions include the design and implementation of verified inference components, the formalization of GPU kernel semantics, the development of AI-assisted proof engineering workflows, and the open-source release of specifications, proofs, and verified artefacts.

We seek an excellent software engineer to play a central role in turning verified research prototypes into a production-grade, high-performance inference engine. Prior experience with formal verification is welcome but not required: a strong systems engineer with the motivation to learn proof-assistant technology will thrive in this role.

Main Duties And Responsibilities

Bring technical expertise in systems programming and performance engineering to support the project’s research; collaborate with the research teams at EPFL and Imperial College London
Design, implement, and maintain core components of the verified LLM inference engine, including the runtime and glue code connecting extracted verified code, GPU kernels, and drivers
Organize and manage the project’s engineering infrastructure: differential testing against reference engines (vLLM, SGLang), continuous integration for code and proofs, and performance benchmarking
Develop and maintain agentic AI pipelines for specification autoformalization, proof generation, and proof repair
Write documentation, procedures, and recommendations to ensure reproducibility of the project’s artefacts
Diagnose, prevent, and repair failures and regressions across the software stack
Analyze the security level and trusted computing base of the components we develop, and contribute to red/blue team exercises within the ARIA programme
Contribute to open-source releases and engage with their user communities

Profile

Higher degree in computer science or education deemed equivalent; experience in the field
Excellent technical knowledge of systems programming, and strong programming ability in several of: Python, C/C++, Rust, OCaml, or other functional languages
Knowledge of one or more of the following, with strong motivation to grow in the others:
GPU programming (CUDA, Triton, PTX) or high-performance computing
ML inference or serving systems (vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch internals, or similar)
Interactive theorem proving (Rocq, Lean, HOL, Isabelle, or similar) or other formal methods

Experience maintaining development tooling: build systems, continuous integration, and test infrastructure
Experience using LLM-based development tools or building agentic workflows is a plus
Mastery of English indispensable (oral and written); French is an asset but not required
Sense of priorities, integrity, and autonomy in your work
Team spirit and aptitude for conducting technical investigations and implementations; excellent ability to communicate with varied audiences, from proof engineers to systems researchers
Strong sense of service and spirit of initiative

We offer

The possibility to join a dynamic and stimulating team on a high-profile ARIA-funded project
A multicultural and academic working environment of high quality
Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
Excellent working conditions
Generous access to frontier AI models and high-performance compute
Funded travel for collaboration between Lausanne and London, and for conferences

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And In One PDF

A CV, including links to open-source contributions or representative projects where applicable.
Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: Nate Foster (nate.foster@epfl.ch).

More information can be found on https://laser.epfl.ch/.

suchen wir eine/n (Senior)

Du entwickelst moderne Webanwendungen im .NET-Ökosystem und bringst deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein.
Du gestaltest und implementierst Backend-Services und entwickelst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter.

Du setzt Frontend-Features mit Frameworks und Technologien wie Angular, React, Vue oder Blazor WebAssembly um.
Du sorgst durch Code-Reviews, automatisierte Tests und Clean-Code-Prinzipien für sauberen, wartbaren und qualitativ hochwertigen Code.
Du unterstützt Junior- und Mid-Level-Entwickler:innen fachlich und übernimmst technische Verantwortung für Projekte oder größere Funktionsbereiche.

Das erwartet dich

Eine abwechslungsreiche Position in einem erfolgreichen Team mit einer offenen Unternehmenskultur und flachen Hierarchien
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit der Möglichkeit, auch von zu Hause zu arbeiten
Systematischer Wissensaustausch und -aufbau mit erfahrenen Kollegen
Zahlreiche Benefits
Ein leistungsbezogenes Vergütungsmodel

Das zeichnet dich aus

Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung als Fullstack-Entwickler:in mit Schwerpunkt C# und bereits praktische Erfahrung mit IoT-Projekten gesammelt.

Du bist in der Lage, den technischen Überblick über mehrere Entwicklungsaufgaben hinweg zu behalten und Entwickler:innen unterschiedlicher Erfahrungsstufen fachlich zu unterstützen.
Du beherrschst C#, .NET, Entity Framework und gängige Architekturmuster sicher und möchtest dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich vertiefen.
Du bringst Erfahrung mit modernen JavaScript-Frameworks beziehungsweise Frontend-Technologien wie Angular, React, Vue oder Blazor WebAssembly mit und bist offen dafür, neue Technologien zu erlernen.
Du fühlst dich im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken und SQL sicher und hast idealerweise auch Erfahrung mit NoSQL-Technologien.
Du kennst die Grundlagen von CI/CD, Container-Technologien wie Docker und Kubernetes sowie Cloud-Umgebungen wie Microsoft Azure oder AWS. Idealerweise hast du diese Technologien bereits in Projekten eingesetzt.
Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

jobs.description:
Alicante, Spain or Warsaw, Poland · Hybrid · Permanent

About Omada Identity

Omada Identity is a leading cloud-based Identity Governance and Administration platform. We help enterprises ensure that the right people and the right non-human identities have the right access to the right resources, at the right time.
We work with security-conscious enterprises across regulated industries. Our customers rely on us to govern access for tens of thousands of identities across hybrid environments. We are recognized by industry analysts as a leader in the IGA space.

About the team

FT8 is the Analytics team within Omada Identity, a leading Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform. We own the data and reporting layer of the product: the Omada Data Warehouse (ODW), History Tracking, Report Generator, Access Navigator and our analytics dashboards. Our work gives customers visibility into who has access to what, how that access changed over time, and whether it complies with policy.
We are a distributed team of eight engineers across Spain and Poland. Our product runs in SaaS (Azure Kubernetes Service, multi-tenant), private cloud and on-premises deployments, so the work we do has to hold up in very different environments.

What you will do

Develop and maintain data pipelines and data models that feed ODW and History Tracking.
Write and improve SQL queries, and help investigate performance and data quality issues.
Develop and maintain backend components in .NET/C#.
Build and improve analytics dashboards and data models in Sisense.
Take part in refinement and code review, working closely with senior engineers on technical design.
Own the quality of your work, including automated testing, as part of our distributed testing model.
Grow your knowledge of our data domain and the wider Omada platform, with support from experienced team members.

What we are looking for

3+ years of professional software development experience.
Solid experience with relational databases, ideally Microsoft SQL Server: writing T-SQL, data modeling and a good understanding of indexing and query performance.
Hands-on experience with .NET and C#.
Experience with, or strong interest in, Business Intelligence platforms (e.g. Sisense, Power BI, Tableau, Qlik).
Eagerness to learn and take ownership of your work.
Comfort working in a distributed team, with strong written and spoken English, as it is our working language.

Nice to have

Hands-on experience with Sisense (ElastiCubes, data models, dashboards).
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts (dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT, historical data).
JavaScript, especially for BI customization (Sisense plugins, BloX, custom widgets).
SSIS or other ETL tooling.
Azure, Docker and Kubernetes.
Azure DevOps (boards, pipelines, repos).
Experience with identity, access management or compliance-driven domains.

What we offer:

Mentorship from experienced engineers.
Structured technical growth.
Modern cloud-native technology stack.
Opportunity to work on an innovative cybersecurity product.
AI-first engineering culture.

Join Our Journey

If you’re a dedicated developer excited about building high-quality, secure cloud-native solutions in a collaborative, agile environment, we’d love to hear from you.
Be part of our Alicante team and help shape the future of self-managed identity solutions – secure, flexible, and truly customer-driven.
Omada is an equal opportunity employer and qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Técnico Senior Web, API & QA

seguimos creciendo y queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un/a Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
, una persona con experiencia trabajando con aplicaciones web y APIs, capacidad para investigar y resolver incidencias técnicas y criterio para validar que una nueva versión está realmente preparada antes de llegar a nuestros clientes.

Buscamos un perfil técnico senior que disfrute entendiendo cómo funcionan las cosas, investigando problemas y trabajando cerca tanto de clientes como de los equipos de Desarrollo, Sistemas y Producto.
Si te gusta un entorno donde puedes tocar producto, soporte avanzado, QA, APIs, despliegues y cliente, este puesto puede ser para ti.

Únete a un equipo donde tu trabajo tiene impacto real

En Provis nos apasiona la tecnología y el fitness
por eso nos especializamos en la gestión de centros deportivos y cadenas de gimnasios.
Trabajamos en un entorno SaaS B2B en el que conviven aplicaciones web, APIs, aplicaciones móviles, software de gestión, pagos, reservas, control de accesos e integraciones con múltiples plataformas externas.
Nuestro día a día requiere personas con capacidad para entender el producto de forma global, tomar ownership de los problemas y colaborar con diferentes equipos hasta encontrar una solución.
No buscamos simplemente alguien que reciba una incidencia y la traslade.
Buscamos alguien que quiera entender qué está pasando, por qué está pasando y cómo podemos evitar que vuelva a ocurrir
.

Cómo será tu día a día

Como Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
, serás una de las referencias técnicas para nuestras soluciones Web y APIs.
Participarás en todo el ciclo de vida de nuestras soluciones: desde una incidencia reportada por un cliente hasta su análisis, escalado, validación de la solución y posterior despliegue.
Trabajarás estrechamente con nuestros equipos de Desarrollo, Sistemas, Producto y Soporte, además de tener contacto directo con clientes cuando sea necesario.
Es un puesto amplio por diseño.
Queremos una persona que pueda desenvolverse cómodamente entre Web, APIs, troubleshooting, QA, releases y soporte técnico avanzado
.

Lo que tendrás bajo tu responsabilidad

Analizar y resolver incidencias técnicas relacionadas con nuestras aplicaciones Web, APIs e integraciones.
Reproducir problemas reportados por clientes e investigar su causa antes de trasladarlos a Desarrollo.
Trabajar con APIs REST mediante herramientas como Postman, Swagger o similares.
Analizar requests, responses, códigos HTTP, autenticación, logs y diferentes comportamientos de una aplicación.
Utilizar las herramientas de desarrollo del navegador para investigar incidencias Web.
Configurar, administrar y poner en marcha nuestras soluciones Web en nuevos clientes.
Realizar configuraciones y modificaciones sobre HTML y CSS cuando sea necesario.
Participar en despliegues y actualizaciones de aplicaciones Web y APIs.
Realizar QA funcional y betatesting de nuevas funcionalidades.
Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba para aplicaciones Web y APIs.
Validar correcciones antes de su publicación.
Realizar pruebas de regresión sobre funcionalidades críticas.
Participar en el proceso de publicación de nuevas versiones y en su validación antes de llegar a producción.
Probar nuevas versiones con clientes beta y realizar seguimiento después del despliegue.
Detectar riesgos o problemas antes de una publicación y comunicarlos de forma clara.
Gestionar y hacer seguimiento de incidencias de soporte técnico N2/N3.
Asegurar que las incidencias que llegan a Desarrollo contienen la información necesaria para analizarlas y reproducirlas.
Participar en reuniones de coordinación con Desarrollo para trasladar incidencias, prioridades y necesidades del cliente.
Hablar directamente con clientes cuando sea necesario para entender o resolver un problema.
Documentar actualizaciones, procedimientos, incidencias y configuraciones.
Compartir conocimiento con el resto del equipo y ayudar a mejorar nuestros procesos de soporte, QA y despliegue.

Lo que buscamos

Experiencia profesional trabajando con aplicaciones Web
.
Buenos conocimientos de HTML y CSS
.
Conocimiento del funcionamiento de una aplicación Web: HTTP, navegador, sesiones, cookies, caché, autenticación, etc.
Experiencia trabajando o realizando pruebas sobre APIs REST
.
Manejo de herramientas como Postman, Swagger o similares
.
Capacidad para utilizar DevTools y otras herramientas de diagnóstico.
Conocimientos de SQL que permitan investigar incidencias y trabajar con datos.
Experiencia investigando y resolviendo problemas técnicos.
Experiencia en QA, testing funcional, soporte técnico avanzado o validación de software.
Capacidad para estructurar y documentar correctamente una incidencia técnica.
Buena comunicación y comodidad tratando directamente con clientes.
Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y asumir responsabilidad sobre los temas que gestiona.
Mentalidad analítica, curiosidad técnica y ganas de entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

Nos encantará especialmente si además tienes experiencia en...

Entornos SaaS B2B.
Soporte técnico N2/N3 o Application Support.
Procesos de publicación y despliegue de software.
Git y procesos CI/CD.
Aplicaciones móviles.
Automatización de pruebas con Ranorex, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium o herramientas similares.
Integraciones entre diferentes plataformas mediante APIs.
Sistemas de ticketing y gestión de incidencias.
Trabajo con clientes técnicos o equipos de IT.
Inglés técnico.

Importante:
no esperamos que cumplas absolutamente todos los puntos.
Si tienes una buena base en Web/APIs, eres una persona técnica, resolutiva y con capacidad de aprendizaje, queremos conocerte.
Preferimos encontrar una gran persona con capacidad para crecer que un CV que simplemente marque todas las casillas.

¿Por qué puede ser un gran siguiente paso?

Este no es un puesto donde te limitarás a realizar siempre la misma función.
Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar de extremo a extremo:
Cliente → incidencia → diagnóstico → Desarrollo → QA → release → producción.

Eso significa:
Autonomía real.
Problemas técnicos diferentes cada día.
Contacto directo con Desarrollo, Sistemas y Producto.
Visibilidad sobre cómo funciona una plataforma SaaS compleja.
Capacidad para proponer cambios y mejorar procesos.
Posibilidad de convertirte en una referencia técnica dentro del área Web y APIs.
Participación directa en proyectos e implantaciones para algunos de nuestros principales clientes.

¿Por qué ProviSport?

Somos la empresa líder en tecnológica especializada en el sector fitness y deportivo.
Nuestro software es utilizado diariamente por cadenas de gimnasios, centros deportivos y millones de usuarios, y seguimos evolucionando nuestra plataforma, nuestras APIs y nuestras aplicaciones para acompañar el crecimiento de nuestros clientes.
Estamos en un momento en el que queremos seguir elevando nuestro nivel técnico, mejorar nuestros procesos de QA y despliegue y construir una organización cada vez más sólida y escalable.
Por eso buscamos personas que quieran aportar, cuestionar, mejorar y asumir responsabilidad
.

Qué ofrecemos

🚀 Incorporarte a una compañía tecnológica en crecimiento y con un producto consolidado.
💻 Trabajar con aplicaciones Web, APIs, mobile e integraciones reales en producción.
🧠 Un puesto con un componente técnico elevado y mucha variedad.
🤝 Contacto directo con diferentes áreas técnicas y con clientes.
📈 Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.
🏡 Modalidad híbrida.
📍 Oficinas en Zaragoza.
📚 Formación continua y aprendizaje sobre producto, tecnología e integraciones.
💼 Contrato indefinido y jornada completa de lunes a viernes.

Nuestra forma de trabajar

Valoramos especialmente a las personas que toman ownership y tenga actitud positiva
.
Si algo falla, queremos entenderlo.
Si un proceso puede mejorarse, queremos cambiarlo.
Si una incidencia llega incompleta, queremos hacer las preguntas necesarias antes de escalarla.
Y si una versión no está preparada para llegar a nuestros clientes, esperamos que alguien tenga el criterio y la responsabilidad para decirlo.
Buscamos personas cercanas, profesionales, técnicas y con ganas de construir conjuntamente.

¿Te interesa?

Si te gusta trabajar con Web, APIs, QA y resolución de problemas técnicos
, y buscas un puesto en el que puedas tener impacto sobre producto y clientes, nos encantará conocerte.
Aplica directamente a través de LinkedIn y nuestro equipo se pondrá en contacto contigo.

El proceso de selección

El proceso será sencillo y directo:
Primera conversación para conocernos y explicarte el proyecto y el puesto.
Entrevista técnica con responsables del área.
Pequeño caso práctico orientado a diagnóstico Web/API y QA.
Conversación final con el equipo.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you think like an engineer first, and a language specialist second?

We are looking for engineers who want to build t he next generation of cloud-native financial technology.

Our platforms run on .NET and Java, but we are not looking for C# or Java developers (or Python developers, or developers of any other language). We are looking for software engineers
, because what matters is that you can reason about distributed systems, become productive quickly in an unfamiliar codebase — including one written in a language you have not used before — and use AI as a real engineering partner rather than an autocomplete tool.

We build a cloud-native core banking platform
that safeguards billions of euros of real customers' money. The bar for reliability, scalability, and security is exceptionally high, and we are continuously reinventing how we build software. If you want to help shape the future of engineering rather than watch it happen, we'd love to talk to you.

Briefing

Ohpen launched the world's first cloud-native core banking platform. We don't just use technology - we build it, and we operate it in production for regulated financial institutions.

You'll join a cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of a domain: design, build, deploy, operate, support. Not a ticket queue. Deployment is where the value gets delivered, so it isn't a step you hand to another team once the code is written. You'll be accountable for how your services behave in production, not only for how they look at code review.

You'd be working on a platform that has been live and evolving for more than a decade. A lot of the work is understanding, extending, and safely replacing systems that carry real business logic for real clients. The interesting problem here is not writing code quickly — that is now cheap. It is knowing what to change, what it will break, and how to prove it worked.

AI is a first-class tool in that work (expected, not just tolerated). You'll use it to build context on unfamiliar code, explore designs, generate and review implementations, and remove routine work. You stay in the driver's seat: you decide what to accept, what to challenge, and when the model is confidently wrong.

About You

You're a generalist by instinct.
You've worked in more than one language or platform, and you'd learn another if the job needed it. You don't introduce yourself as a C# or a Java developer.
You've run what you built.
Distributed, event-driven backend systems in production — headless, API-first, where the numbers had to be right and downtime had real consequences.
You think in systems.
Where the coupling sits, what a change is likely to break, how the pieces talk to each other. You will design clear boundaries around complex banking domains, keep API changes backward compatible, and choose simple designs by default. For workflows where reads, writes, and audit requirements differ, you’ll use separate models when the trade-off earns its cost.
You're comfortable in code you didn't write
. Working out how an existing system actually does, rather than what its documentation claims, is a skill you enjoy using.
You use AI deliberately.
You know how to give a model the context it needs, how to direct it on a large unfamiliar codebase, and judge whether what comes back is any good. You have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.
You own things in production.
Cloud, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability are part of your job, not another team's. We run on AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, EventBridge, SNS and SQS, but equivalent experience on any major cloud is just as welcome.
You make your reasoning clear.
You can challenge a colleague or client directly and respectfully, explaining the trade-off and proposing a better path.

Why us?

Cutting-edge technology in fintech
Highly qualified colleagues to learn from
A friendly, multicultural environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact
Hybrid working setup with flexible hours
Work from Anywhere policy
Language classes and continuous learning and development
Home office setup support
Mental health and wellbeing support
Flexible retribution options (Barcelona)
Weekly team lunches, wellbeing activities, and regular team events

Senior .NET Engineer

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack, AI-Native), Senior-Level
jobs.description:
At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 30 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation.

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack, AI-Native)
who shares our passion for innovation and high-velocity engineering. Operating embedded alongside product teams in an AI-agentic delivery workflow, you will bridge technical decision-making with hands-on full-stack development making key architectural choices, validating AI-generated code, and shipping resilient .NET, React, and integrated solutions directly to production.

Role Summary

This role owns end-to-end delivery on a highly transactional booking platform serving 8 markets in 2 languages. You take features from technical solutioning to production across the full stack: React/TypeScript frontends, the .NET services and BFF, and the booking, payments and loyalty integrations underneath.

You work embedded with the Product team inside an agentic delivery workflow. By the time a feature reaches you, requirements and designs have already been analysed against the current codebase by AI agents, and you get a mapped impact and a set of implementation options with pros and cons. Your job is to challenge that analysis, make the final technical decision, and implement it across the stack yourself.

The role is hands-on and autonomous. You're expected to get productive quickly in an existing codebase, decide within your scope without waiting to be unblocked, and escalate only the decisions that really need it. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) are the default way of working. What we value most is judgement about when to trust, verify or rewrite what they produce.

Core Responsibilities

End-to-end technical solutioning

Review agent-generated impact analysis and solution options for each feature, validate them against the real codebase, and make the final technical decision with clear reasoning.
Own the solution design across frontend, BFF, backend services and integrations, including the trade-offs on performance, risk and delivery time.
Work directly with Product, Design and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, flag technical constraints early, and shape scope.

Full-stack development

Build and ship features across React/TypeScript frontends and .NET services and BFF.
Own integration contracts for booking, payments and loyalty, including failure handling, idempotency and retry behaviour on transactions.
Work with CMS-driven content (Strapi) and across web and mobile client surfaces.

AI-native delivery

Use agentic coding tools as the default mode for implementation, refactoring, test generation and codebase exploration.
Keep context artifacts current (repo conventions, agent instruction files, prompts and scripts) so the whole team and the agents work from the same foundation.
Help define the team's rules for AI-assisted work: what agents do, what they don't, and what must be human-verified before merge.

Quality and production ownership

Review PRs, human- and AI-authored, watching for hallucinated APIs, deprecated calls, hidden complexity on hot paths, and tests that assert nothing.
Take part in RCA on production failures and turn findings into fixes, logging and guardrails.
Act as a technical counterpart to the Technical Director, Product and QA, making decisions within your scope rather than escalating by default.
Tooling & Stack
Frontend: React
TypeScript
Flutter (mobile surface)
Backend: C# / .NET 8+
ASP.NET Core
REST APIs / BFF pattern
Redis
AI & agentic workflow: Claude Code
OpenAI Codex
GitHub Copilot
MCP servers
agent instruction files
Platform: Azure
Docker
GitHub Actions
ArgoCD
New Relic
Integrations: Checkout.com (payments, 3DS)
Strapi CMS
Experience & Skills

Must have

7+ years in software engineering, with strong production experience in both C#/.NET backend and React/TypeScript frontend, and still writing production code daily.
A track record of taking features end to end, from technical design to production, in an existing codebase.
Daily use of agentic coding tools on production code, with concrete examples of what changed in your delivery: scope, cycle time, test coverage, or refactors you wouldn't otherwise have attempted.
The ability to evaluate AI-proposed solutions critically and make sound technical decisions autonomously, knowing when to decide and when to escalate.
A strong code review practice, including a clear personal method for catching AI-generated defects.
Experience integrating third-party transactional APIs (payments, PSPs, booking or ticketing engines) where partial failure has commercial consequences.
Experience in fast-paced delivery with short cycles, feature flags and frequent releases.
Comfort working directly with client-side product and business stakeholders, in English.

Strongly preferred

Set or documented AI-assisted development standards for a team (review policy, agent instructions, prompt or context libraries).
High-volume transactional or booking platforms, and multi-market or multi-currency systems.
Azure, distributed tracing, and production debugging with New Relic or similar.
Flutter or mobile experience, and CMS-driven content.

This job can be filled in Dubai, United Arab Emirates Onsite

We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process. Compensation is determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and location. new_jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

At TOPIC, we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the driven and ambitious Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)who enjoys writing production-quality code to automate testing of complex embedded systems that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

As an Software Development Engineer in Test, you operate at the intersection of software development and quality engineering. You design and build high-quality test infrastructure and automation in the same way developers build production systems. With your strong programming skills in C++and/or Python, you ensure software is testable, scalable, and reliable by design. You work closely with software engineers on complex high-tech systems, contributing directly to codebases, test architecture, and continuous integration pipelines. Rather than only validating software, you actively shape how it is built and verified.

Your responsibilities as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET):

Design, develop, and maintain test frameworks and automation tooling using C++ and/or Python
Contribute to production code and testability improvements in collaboration with software engineers
Develop automated tests across multiple levels (unit, integration, system) as part of the development process
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure to enable fast and reliable feedback
Analyze complex systems and failures, and trace issues to root cause in code
Drive testability, observability, and quality-by-design principles within development teams
Work on high-tech systems (embedded / hardware-software integration / distributed systems) with real-world impact
Take ownership of technical decisions around test architecture and tooling
Continuously improve automation strategy with a strong focus on engineering scalability and maintainability

Job Requirements

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

Challenging and interesting projects in different domains
Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues
Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions
Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy
Tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

Permanent contract
An all-in employment package between €57,000 and €76.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise
26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands)

This will keep you healthy:

A good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working
An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym
The home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment
Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks

What do you bring as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar
5 years of work experience in the high‑tech domain
Experience with programming in Python, C++ and/or C# and familiar with applying OO principles.
Hands‑on experience with test automation
Preferably experience with the ROBOT Framework and methodologies such as TDD, BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

This role will join the Digital Services team, part of Change and Technology Services within the Insolvency Service, supporting enterprise applications used by internal teams, external organisations and the general public.

The team is consolidating its technology stack and moving away from legacy services, with a growing focus on Microsoft .NET 10 and Azure. This is a strong opportunity to help modernise digital services, influence technical approaches and contribute to a more sustainable, user-centred technology environment.

The role will also contribute to the ongoing improvement of a portfolio of live digital services, helping reduce technical debt, improve consistency across the technology estate and support faster, more effective delivery of future change.

Responsibilities of a Senior Developer

Design, develop and maintain secure, accessible and maintainable applications across enterprise digital services.
Deliver functionality against agreed user stories, acceptance criteria and Agile delivery objectives.
Take ownership of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, defect prevention and addressing technical debt.
Contribute to architectural discussions, engineering standards, reusable components and common development approaches.
Support live services through incident resolution, releases, deployments, documentation and ongoing continuous improvement.

Essential criteria for a Senior Developer

C# and .NET development experience within modern web applications.
Experience of modern engineering practices including TDD/BDD, automated testing, CI/CD and DevOps.
Good understanding of integration approaches including APIs, real-time, scheduled, batch and messaging services.
Experience working with cloud-based IaaS and PaaS solutions, alongside strong knowledge of secure and maintainable software development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to contribute to technical discussions, share knowledge and support colleagues.

Desirable criteria for a Senior Developer

Experience working with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, App Services, Function Apps and AI Search.
Knowledge of clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, RESTful APIs and GitHub-based development workflows.
Experience of GOV.UK standards, including the Service Manual and Technology Code of Practice.

Benefits

Alongside your salary of up to £57,722, Insolvency Service contributes £14,029 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. We want you to have a good work-life balance and want to support you in all that you do, so they offer a great benefits package including:

Cycle to Work scheme
Access to Workplace Wellness, the employee assistance programme offering confidential and independent support and advice

Office locations

The role is open across 9 of Insolvency Service locations:
Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham

Additional Requirements

Expectation is to spend 60% of your working time in one of the offices.
This role operates under the flexible working hours agreement, supporting a positive work-life balance
The post is subject to SC level clearance, a requirement for which you must have resided in the UK for a minimum of 5 years.

The Insolvency Service does not
currently hold this licence and therefore cannot legally sponsor Skilled Worker visa applicants.

This is an opportunity to join the Insolvency Service at an important point in its technology journey.

You will be working on a wider programme to maintain, improve and modernise more than 10 digital services, helping the team move away from older applications and inconsistent technologies towards a more focused and maintainable Microsoft-based environment.

new_jobs.description:
We’re the Moonpig Group – home to Moonpig, Greetz, Red Letter Days and Buyagift – and we’re on a mission to make people feel loved, celebrated and remembered. Whether it’s a card that gets them laughing out loud or a gift that makes their day, we help people stay close, no matter the miles.

We’re proud to be leading the online gifting revolution, with brilliant products, clever tech and a whole lot of heart. Our platform makes it easy to create moments that matter – packed with personal touches and delivered with care.

We’re not just about selling cards or gifts – we’re here to spread joy, spark smiles and make every celebration feel extra special. And with values that guide how we work and support one another, we’ve built a place where people (and ideas) can truly thrive.

If you’re looking to make an impact, bring your spark and be part of something meaningful – we’d love to have you on the team. 🌙🐷

Senior Engineering Manager – Maternity Cover | 📍Manchester or London – Hybrid (1–2 days per week) | 💰Competitive Salary + Benefits
About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager
to join Moonpig on a fixed-term maternity cover contract of around 9–10 months
, with availability to start in November 2026
.

You’ll provide people and technical leadership across teams within our Top of Funnel area, helping millions of customers navigate, discover and explore Moonpig’s product catalogue. It’s a role for someone who enjoys building strong engineering teams while staying connected to the technology, product direction and decisions that shape what we build.

People leadership will be a big part of your role. You’ll coach and support engineers, foster an inclusive and collaborative environment, and help people grow their skills, confidence and ownership. Alongside this, you’ll partner closely with Product, Design and Engineering Leads to shape roadmaps, explore opportunities and make thoughtful decisions about our technical direction.

You’ll stay close enough to the technology to contribute meaningfully to conversations around architecture, engineering quality and delivery, while empowering engineers to make decisions at the right level.

Our expectations of our Engineering Managers:

Building culture:
“Culture eats process for breakfast” and we wholeheartedly believe this. As an Engineering Manager you are responsible for fostering a growth culture and contributing to our management best practices. You help us become an exceptional place to work for the ambitious, highly motivated people we hire. Your team of engineers are responsible for various services and you advocate the mantra “You build it, you run it”. At the end of the day, you have a massive influence on our overall engineering quality and culture and you actively work to continuously improve this

People progression:
As an Engineering Manager you are also expected to focus on the progression of people. Fifty percent of your time will be focussed on coaching, 121’s, mentoring and driving a high performance engineering culture. You need to be empathetic towards an individual’s needs and ensure we support and grow our engineers. You’ll identify which skill sets are required for the successful delivery of projects, coaching or recruiting engineers to cover any skill shortages

Driving good Engineering:
As an Engineering Manager you’ll lead by example, demonstrating best practices, working with your engineers through regular pairing sessions or providing technical leadership to help deliver new features, ensuring that the design and development of our systems adhere to good engineering principles

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and support engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, timely feedback, career development and performance conversations

Foster an inclusive, collaborative and learning-focused engineering culture where people feel comfortable sharing ideas, challenging decisions and learning from each other

Partner with Product and Design to shape roadmaps and product direction, bringing an engineering perspective to discovery, prioritisation and trade-offs

Help engineers get involved early in discovery and problem shaping rather than Engineering operating solely as a downstream delivery function

Stay close to system design, architecture and technical direction, helping teams make high-quality decisions without becoming the default decision-maker

Encourage pragmatic technical choices that favour simplicity and make effective use of existing software and shared capabilities

Support Engineering Leads and teams with planning, estimation, sequencing, dependencies, risks and transparent communication around delivery

Balance customer and business outcomes with appropriate investment in reliability, maintainability and longer-term engineering quality

Champion strong engineering practices, including test-driven development and automated testing, helping teams build quality into the development process

Support strong operational ownership through CI/CD, observability, production support and the principle that teams own the systems they build and run

Help teams identify and address technical debt sustainably while maintaining appropriate technical and operational documentation

Build technical leadership throughout the teams, using the experience and strengths of engineers at different levels rather than concentrating technical authority in one role

Collaborate across Product, Design, Data/Data Science, CRM, Commercial and specialist functions where relevant, creating clarity around priorities, risks, dependencies and trade-offs

Support team capability planning, identifying opportunities to develop skills and strengthen engineering capability

About You:

Experience leading software engineering teams as an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or in a comparable people-leadership role

Strong people leadership experience, including coaching, career development, feedback and performance management

Engineering expertise with enough technical depth to contribute credibly to full-stack and cloud system design, architecture, engineering quality and operational conversations

A collaborative leadership style that enables engineers and Engineering Leads to own decisions rather than relying on the manager for every answer

Experience building strong Product and Engineering partnerships and involving engineers in discovery, problem shaping and roadmap decisions

Experience sharing accountability for customer or business outcomes and translating these into clear engineering priorities

Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing and TDD principles, CI/CD, observability and production ownership

Experience facilitating technical decisions, bringing the right people and evidence together and constructively challenging thinking when needed

Comfortable balancing feature delivery and experimentation with reliability, technical quality and sustainable engineering investment

Ability to collaborate and influence across disciplines while communicating technical decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly

Commitment to creating an inclusive environment where engineers can grow, challenge ideas, give and receive feedback and take meaningful ownership

Available to start in  November 2026
for the fixed-term maternity cover period

Our Tech Environment:

Our Top of Funnel teams work across full-stack customer experiences and highly scalable cloud and distributed systems. The environment includes:

C# / .NET and Node.js / TypeScript
across modern backend and full-stack development

React and GraphQL
within our web and API ecosystem

AWS
, including cloud and serverless architecture

OpenSearch
, alongside integrations with our content management, search and recommendations capabilities

Terraform
for infrastructure as code

GitHub/GitLab
and CI/CD practices supporting frequent, reliable delivery

Grafana and AWS CloudWatch
for monitoring and observability

Automated testing and engineering practices focused on building quality into the development lifecycle

Production health, incident management and strong operational ownership

Experimentation and data-informed product development, including A/B testing and hypothesis-led approaches

Sustainable technical debt management and technical documentation, including architecture and operational guidance

Our Interview Process:

Stage 1:
Recruiter Screening Call 15-30mins

Stage 2:
Hiring Manager Call 30mins

Stage 3:
System design interview 60mins

Stage 4:
Culture/team fit interview with Key Stakeholder 30mins

Stage 5:
Final culture/team fit interview with Senior team/Hiring Manager 30mins

Offer! 🎉

Please note:
Our interview process may vary depending on the specific role, hiring team availability, or other business needs. We aim to keep candidates informed of any changes throughout the process.

What's in it for you?

We believe in empowering our team to do their best work. Enjoy:

💰 Competitive Pay & Bonuses: Plus, generous pension plans & staff discounts.

💆🏽 Wellbeing First: Private healthcare (UK) and mental health support 

🏖️ Flexible Working & Time Off: Generous holidays, hybrid working (1-3 days in office, depending on role/team) & up to 20 days of international working.

📈 Career Growth: Learning allowances, coaching & development programs.

Want to know more?

Explore our full benefits package: here

Check out our podcast , tech blog and product blog to hear more about how we work and what we're building!

Our Ways of Working:

We trust our colleagues to do what’s right and offer flexibility to support a balance between work and life. At the same time, face-to-face office time is an important and expected part of working at Moonpig Group. We believe regular in-person working supports collaboration, alignment, and effective decision-making. Candidates will have regular and ongoing time working from the office as part of their role, which will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Moonpig Group's Commitment to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusivity:

At Moonpig Group, we’re all about creating a workplace where everyone feels they truly belong. We celebrate what makes each of us unique, whether that’s our background, how we work best, or what matters most to us.

From working parents who need flexible hours to neurodiverse colleagues with specific working styles, we’re here to support our people in ways that work for them. Because when you feel valued and included, you can thrive, and so can we.

We’re proud to have a number of employee-led groups driving this forward, including our LGBTQ+, Gender Balance, Neurodiversity and EMBRACE (Educating Myself for Better Racial Awareness and Cultural Enrichment) communities, plus our Group-wide EDI committee. These teams help make sure every voice is heard and every idea has a place.

We know that diversity fuels creativity, innovation and connection, and that’s why we’ll keep pushing for progress. Together, we’re building a culture where everyone feels safe, supported, and free to be their brilliant, authentic selves.

A twelve month architecture role on a live, cloud native public sector digital service that is in Beta and about to scale hard.

No security clearance required. BPSS only.

THE ROLE
You would provide architecture leadership across a distributed, cloud native service, working alongside the engineering teams rather than above them.
The service is live in Beta and preparing for significant growth, so the work splits three ways. Delivering the remaining functional capability. Getting the non functionals ready for large scale adoption. And the architecture that lets it scale to full production.

Architecture leadership across a distributed, cloud native service

Producing architecture artefacts and supporting governance

Supporting readiness for large scale adoption

Technical architect, solution architect, or a hybrid of both

Comfortable at strategic and technical levels, without hands on coding

ADVANTAGEOUS
Taking a service through Beta into large scale production

Rate: £600 per day, inside IR35

You will work and consult with GTM team members and a diverse array of customers to successfully roll out product analytics to their organization and execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers.

As a Delivery Engineer, you will be on the front lines with our clients as they integrate Mixpanel into their core product development processes. With your comprehensive project management knowledge, consultative approach, expertise in the analytics space, and technical knowledge of the modern data stack, you will lead our clients' first experience with Mixpanel as they incorporate product analytics into their data ecosystem as a foundational element. Align with pre-sales teams and consult with prospects/clients to define business goals and metrics to guide data architecture and project outcomes

Consult with customers on integrating their agentic workflows with Mixpanel data.

Can manage complex projects with assorted client stakeholders, working across teams and departments to execute real change while managing scope and timelines
Has embedded AI into their workflows and is familiar with using MCP servers, building new skills, setting context, and can credibly consult with our customers about their AI/data strategy
Has experience in customer success, client-facing professional services, consulting, or technical project management role
Excellent written, analytical, and communication skills

Eager to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving customer needs

new_jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About The Job You're Considering

Capgemini are recruiting for experienced Quality Engineers at a Senior and Lead level.

We have vacancies for Senior and Lead Quality Engineers to join our dynamic team building solutions for our public sector client. Working with us will mean delivering critical digital services from cradle to grave working on a variety of projects featuring high-performance cloud platforms using Java based languages and technologies, and on-premises traditional infrastructure.

As a member of our self-empowered, multi-disciplined teams, you’ll have the freedom to shape the way you work using the latest industry practices, tools and technologies, while collaborating in our mature Agile environment alongside specialists from other disciplines.

Additionally, we expect Lead Quality Engineers to possess advanced technical expertise, strong problem-solving abilities, and a proven track record of leading complex engineering projects. This role requires a deep understanding of engineering principles, quality assurance, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

Hybrid working:
Your working location will vary depending on your role, personal needs, and business requirements. This will typically include a mix of company offices, client sites, and remote work from home. If your location is Telford or Hove you will be expected to work from the office between 40% and 70% of the time. For all other locations you need to be prepared to come into the Telford or Hove office once to twice a month (Lead Engineers more frequently). As we align closely with customer requirements—which may change over time—you will need to remain flexible. Please note that fully remote working (100% from home) is not permitted.

Your role

As a Quality Engineer, you'll play a key role in assuring the quality of complex software solutions, working across both system-to-system and user interface-based projects. You'll collaborate closely with delivery teams to drive quality throughout the development lifecycle, applying modern engineering practices and helping teams build reliable, scalable, and high-performing solutions.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will:

Lead by example as a hands-on quality engineering practitioner, contributing to all aspects of software testing.
Design and execute test scenarios, scripts, and test data requirements, including working with external and third-party systems.
Shape and implement effective test automation strategies using industry best practices.
Develop automated tests using technologies such as Java, Scala, .NET, or JavaScript, and advocate for approaches including TDD and BDD.
Collaborate with stakeholders, architects, developers, and product teams to influence solution design and delivery planning.
Mentor and support junior engineers, promoting technical excellence, wellbeing, and professional development.

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will additionally:

Provide technical leadership across quality engineering activities, ensuring successful delivery of high-quality solutions.
Define and drive quality engineering strategy, standards, and best practices across projects and programmes.
Champion innovation by identifying and implementing modern testing approaches, tools, and engineering solutions.
Lead collaboration across multiple teams and disciplines to enable seamless integration and delivery.
Act as a senior mentor and role model, developing engineering capability and fostering a culture of continuous learning.
Support the technical and career development of engineers through coaching, performance management, and leadership.

Our culture

We’re looking for people who are learning focused, challenge the status quo and are constantly looking to shape their working environment to make it an exciting, fun and interesting place to work.

Keeping things fresh is something we encourage in our working practices, but the culture of continuous improvement is equally as important in our technical approach to building and delivering modern digital services. Your knowledge and experience will be used to change the way we build solutions including utilising new tools and technologies to solve new problems or improve existing services.

Working on our services means you’ll be part of a team, but you’ll also be a part of communities of interest. This means you’ll always have people on hand to share and discuss ideas and get help when needed. The engineering organisation is engineering led, supporting each other through coaching and mentoring, so if you want to change something it’s within your power to do so.

Your Skills And Experience

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of the QA process, knowledge in defining, implementing test designs and broad experience across test levels.

Hands-on experience using and maintaining automated test frameworks (e.g, Cucumber, JUnit)
Knowledge of stubbing / mocking frameworks such as Wiremock
Understanding of Non-Functional testing such as Performance, Security or Accessibility testing
Experience / Understanding of Git or other version control systems
Strong experience of iterative / incremental software delivery
Hands on experience of all levels of the test automation pyramid
Experienced in API testing and tools
Experienced in Functional or System Testing
Experience using project management tooling (e.g. JIRA)
Good knowledge of Agile methodologies

Working across Business, Architecture, Product, Engineering, Delivery and Operations, you’ll provide the architectural direction needed to turn ambition into deliverable solutions. You’ll evaluate options and trade-offs, own High Level Designs and take solutions through architecture governance, providing engineering teams with clear decisions, principles and guardrails for detailed design and implementation.

Own the end-to-end solution architecture for large, complex transformation initiatives, from early discovery and requirements through governance, engineering handover and delivery

Translate business capabilities and outcomes into coherent architectures spanning applications, integration, data, security, resilience, nonfunctional requirements and operational considerations
Produce Solution Options Papers and High-Level Designs, assessing technology, business, commercial, delivery and operational trade-offs and setting clear architectural direction and guardrails
Lead solutions through formal architecture governance, including design reviews, Architecture Decision Records and governance boards, responding to challenge and ensuring decisions and actions are progressed
Partner with Product, Engineering and Delivery teams throughout Agile transformation delivery, providing effective handover into detailed design while remaining engaged to resolve architectural issues, risks and dependencies

Proven experience operating as a Solution Architect within large, complex transformation programmes, owning solution direction from discovery through to delivery
Strong Microsoft Dynamics 365 architecture experience, including designing its integration with wider enterprise platforms, data, digital channels and legacy systems
Strong end to end solution design capability across applications, integration, data, security, resilience, operational requirements and nonfunctional requirements
